jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Avanade is a global leader in digital and cloud services, business solutions, and design‑led applications. As a joint venture of Microsoft and Accenture, we are the world’s largest consulting company focused exclusively on Microsoft technologies.

We support our clients across Cloud, Modern Workplace, Business Applications, Data & AI, and Security
, and place a strong emphasis on our #PeopleFirst
culture.

Shape the Future of Cloud Transformation

Are you passionate about designing innovative cloud solutions that help organizations transform and thrive? Do you enjoy combining strategic architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership? If so, we invite you to join our growing Azure Platform team.

As an Azure Cloud Architect, you will work with enterprise clients to design, build, and modernize cloud platforms leveraging the full power of Microsoft Azure. You will help organizations accelerate their cloud journey while ensuring security, scalability, resilience, and operational excellence.

You act as a key interface between business, project management, development, operations, and external stakeholders, taking ownership of architectural decisions and providing technical leadership across projects.

Your Responsibilities

Design resilient, scalable, and secure Azure cloud architectures for enterprise customers.
Lead the design and implementation of Azure Landing Zones that establish a compliant and secure cloud foundation.
Architect and drive complex migrations of infrastructure, applications, and databases from on-premises environments to Azure.
Design and implement cloud-native solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions, and modern Azure platform services.
Develop hybrid and edge cloud solutions that integrate Azure with existing enterprise environments.
Define cloud governance, security, identity, networking, and compliance standards.
Leverage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates) to automate deployments and platform management and Agentic development and deployment.
Collaborate closely with technical teams, project stakeholders, and executive leadership to ensure successful delivery.
Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to engineering teams.
Support solution development, client workshops, architecture reviews, and pre-sales activities.

Your Profile

Strong hands‑on experience in architecting, implementing, and operating Microsoft Azure solutions
Deep understanding of cloud and enterprise architectures, distributed systems, and hybrid scenarios
Experience with networking, security, and identity concepts (e.g. Azure AD / Entra ID, Zero Trust, private networking)
Knowledge of automation and Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM, Azure DevOps, GitHub)
Experience with integration and data architectures in cloud environments
Solid understanding of governance, ALM, and quality frameworks
Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly and appropriately to different audiences
Strong analytical and conceptual skills
Confident and professional interaction with customers and project stakeholders
Mentoring and coaching mindset toward consultants and engineers
Experience or solid knowledge in data and AI‑based services on Azure (e.g. Azure AI Services, Copilot integration, analytics, automation)
Fluency in German and English is required

Qualifications

What Sets You Apart

Strong communication and presentation skills in German and English
High level of initiative, analytical thinking, and solution‑oriented mindset
Customer‑ and service‑oriented approach with strong persuasion skills
High motivation, sense of ownership, and personal accountability
Ability to quickly grasp complex topics and explain them clearly
Enthusiasm for new and challenging topics and for working in diverse, international teams
Willingness to travel depending on project requirements
Fluent German and English skills (minimum C1)

Grow Your Career with Us

Some Of The Benefits Of Working At Avanade

Opportunity to work for the Microsoft Global Alliance Partner of the Year (14 consecutive years)
Excellent learning and development opportunities, including at least 80 hours of training per year and paid certifications
Collaboration with highly skilled technical experts around the globe
A dedicated career adviser supporting your professional development
A collaborative culture with colleagues who value knowledge sharing and teamwork

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer
to join a dedicated team working on high-impact, enterprise-scale software solutions for public sector funding and financial management systems.

The candidate will work within a large-scale ecosystem comprising core transactional systems, reporting tools, and public application portals. Strong proficiency in C#, .NET Framework 4.8, .NET 6/8, ASP.NET MVC, REST APIs, and Entity Framework Core.

Experience with HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, OpenXML, and modern web frameworks (Angular, React, or Blazor).

Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

(Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)

(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in Tallinn, Berlin or Stockholm

In this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.

The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. Customer Identity Team is responsible for identifying or authenticating good consumers while recognizing and blocking bad actors to protect our consumers, merchants, partners, and Riverty from fraud.

On a daily basis you will

Design, develop, test, document, and operate robust, maintainable software for the Customer Identity Platform.
Participate in the end-to-end product development process and help the team ensure value, usability, feasibility, and viability.
Collaborate as needed with product managers, designers, architects, and other roles to discover the right solutions.
Monitor system health and application metrics for our live-critical platform. Investigate and resolve incidents as needed.
Identify issues, suggest improvements to new and existing features, and present ideas for solutions. Take initiative to improve quality across accessibility, performance, consistency, maintainability, and robustness.
Seek out, evaluate, and recommend new technologies and concepts, helping bring industry standards and best practices into our codebase and architecture.

Qualifications

You will be a strong fit if you have

At least 5 years of professional experience with .NET/C# development.
Strong expertise in RESTful APIs and backend service design.
Experience with microservices architecture, distributed systems, and asynchronous/event-driven communication.
Solid knowledge of application and information security.
Hands-on experience with Azure Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), and modern deployment practices; familiarity with Kubernetes, MongoDB, and Infrastructure as Code is a plus.
Hands-on experience with front-end technologies including TypeScript (React is a plus), or a strong willingness to work full-stack.
Openness to participating in on-call rotations.
Experience with identity and access management technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, Auth0, and PingOne AIC.

As a person you are

Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented.
Confident in communicating with both business and technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English.
Empathetic, collaborative, and receptive to giving and receiving feedback.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Product Tech
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if your leadership could shape large-scale, business-critical digital products across a global organization? At H&M Tech, the Engineering Manager plays a critical leadership role, accountable for technical execution, delivery quality, and operational excellence.

The Product domain provides capabilities to design, create, source, and produce customer‑relevant assortments. It covers the full product lifecycle from product design, sourcing, purchasing, to production execution, and is organized into four focus areas that each own a distinct part of this lifecycle. The Product team will support the Production Office with technology and data use cases that help colleagues explore opportunities, improve decision-making, automate manual work, and create measurable value in production processes.

We are currently recruiting for 3 Engineering Manager positions
within our Product domain. These opportunities span the Product & Purchase
and Product Sourcing
areas, where you will lead one of our engineering teams supporting Sourcing Partnership Flow, Purchase Flow, or Labels & Tags

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Strategic & Delivery Leadership

Own end-to-end technical delivery for one or more large-scale and complex products or services.
In service contexts, own both roadmap and delivery accountability; in product contexts, partner with Product Managers to shape execution.
Translate business and product goals into clear technical direction, execution plans, and measurable outcomes across technology and data-enabled products.
Partner with Production Office stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and deliver technology and data use cases that solve real operational needs and improve ways of working.
Work in close dual leadership with the Product Manager to balance product priorities, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long-term scalability.
Secure and allocate engineering capacity across multiple teams aligned with strategic priorities.
Establish scalable, secure, and resilient data platforms, pipelines, and data products that support analytics, experimentation, and operational use cases.
Lead through senior engineers while retaining overall accountability for engineering quality, delivery timelines, consistent standards, and operational excellence.

Operational Excellence

Shape and enforce engineering quality, simplification, and continuous improvement across teams.
Define and monitor KPIs to drive operational performance and business outcomes.
Ensure stable, resilient, compliant, and secure operations, including effective incident handling and adherence to architectural standards.
Lead proactive management of risks, dependencies, and technical debt.
Embed responsible technology practices into delivery, including privacy, security, bias awareness, monitoring, and clear operational ownership.
Oversee vendor and managed service delivery, ensuring performance, compliance, contractual alignment, and cost efficiency.

Financial Accountability

Own and manage tech costs (budget, forecast, actuals) across large-scale products or services.
Ensure strong financial discipline and cost efficiency aligned with TCO objectives.
Contribute to investment planning and prioritization aligned with business goals.

People & Culture

Lead, coach, mentor, and develop senior engineers, leaders, and teams while setting best practices for engineering excellence.
Build high-performing, inclusive, and psychologically safe environments in the team.
Ensure teams have the right competencies, structure, and support to succeed.
Promote sustainable ways of working and support team well-being.

Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a senior technical leader influencing enterprise-level decisions and priorities.
Collaborate with product, architecture, security, and business stakeholders to align direction.

Ensure transparency with clear communication of progress, risks, and dependencies.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will lead an engineering team within one of our Product Tech areas—Product & Purchase or Product Sourcing—supporting one of the strategic product teams: Sourcing Partnership Flow, Purchase Flow, or Labels & Tags. You will lead a Product team consisting of various Engineers and operate at the intersection of engineering, data, product, architecture, and business. The team will work closely with the Production Office to understand concrete use cases, shape scalable data and technology solutions, and turn business needs into reliable products that support production teams in their daily work.

You will work in dual leadership with the Product Manager, where you bring engineering leadership, delivery accountability, technical direction, and operational excellence while the Product Manager drives product vision, prioritization, and value realization. Together, you will align priorities, shape the roadmap, and ensure data and digital capabilities are designed, built, governed, and scaled across the Product in close collaboration with architects, specialists, security, analytics, and senior stakeholders.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an experienced 10+ years
engineering leader with a strong track record of delivering complex, large-scale technology solutions. You bring deep technical understanding combined with impactful leadership, enabling teams and leaders to perform at their best.

You thrive in complexity and ambiguity, confidently making trade-offs that balance short-term delivery with long-term scalability, resilience, and quality.

You bring:

Strong experience in s
oftware development, with a solid hands-on background in .NET / C#
.
Strong experience working with Microsoft Azure
and cloud-based technologies.
Corporate leadership experience with direct budget responsibility,
including planning, forecasting, prioritization, cost management and accountability for budget outcomes.
Proven people leadership experience, including recruitment, performance management, coaching, feedback and employee development.
Ownership of delivery outcomes from planning through execution, with accountability for scope, timeline, quality, risks and dependencies.
Engineering leadership in a corporate custom software development environment using Microsoft technologies, including Azure.
Strong technical understanding of modern engineering practices, including agile, DevOps, scalable architecture, cloud platforms, and confidence working closely with engineers on technical decisions and delivery.
Ability to balance business value, technical feasibility, delivery capacity, and long-term scalability while creating clarity across product, engineering, architecture, and business.
Experience working with vendors and external partners.

WHO WE ARE
​

H&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. Learn more about H&M here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE
​

At H&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

We offer all our employees at H&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries.

JOIN US
​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.

Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What We Look For

6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
Documentation and white-boarding skills.
Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
Travel to customers 20% of the time
Databricks Certification

,

What You Will Do

Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking a Senior Software Engineer
to join our AI Engineering team. This is a hands-on, full-stack role
focused on building the front-end and back-end application layers that enable AI teams to deliver enterprise solutions.

You will work alongside AI engineers, data scientists, platform engineers, product teams to move AI use cases from proof of concept into secure, scalable and supportable products. You will build user interfaces in Blazor and React, develop APIs and services in .NET and Python, and integrate applications with generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows and enterprise data services.

This role suits an experienced software engineer who understands that successful AI products require more than a model: they require strong application architecture, thoughtful user experience, robust integration, security, observability, testing and disciplined software delivery.

As this is a Cork-based hybrid role requiring attendance in the office three days per week
, candidates who are not currently based in Cork or the surrounding area would be expected to relocate.

How You Will Do It

Full-stack application engineering

Design, build and maintain production-grade web applications that expose AI capabilities through clear, responsive and accessible user experiences.
Develop component-based front ends using C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript, applying responsive design, accessibility and reusable design-system patterns.
Build secure back-end services and REST APIs using C# and .NET, with Python services where required for AI and data integration.
Design application boundaries, contracts and integration patterns across front ends, APIs, AI services, data stores and enterprise platforms.
Implement authentication, authorisation, input validation, error handling, auditability and secure management of secrets and configuration.
Improve performance, reliability and maintainability through profiling, caching, asynchronous processing and sound engineering patterns.

AI application development

Integrate applications with Azure OpenAI and other approved model endpoints, Azure AI Foundry capabilities, AI Search, vector stores and enterprise APIs.
Build application experiences for conversational AI, enterprise search, document intelligence, summarisation, recommendations and AI-assisted workflows.
Implement streaming responses, citations and source attribution, structured outputs, tool calling, conversation state and human-in-the-loop controls.
Collaborate with AI engineers on RAG and agentic solutions, translating model or workflow capabilities into well-designed user-facing features.
Implement practical safeguards including prompt and output validation, content filtering, access controls, graceful fallback and clear user feedback.
Measure and optimise end-to-end quality, latency, reliability and cost, including the application behaviour around non-deterministic AI responses.

Software delivery and operational excellence

Own features through design, implementation, code review, automated testing, deployment, production support and continuous improvement.
Create unit, component, integration, contract and end-to-end tests using TypeScript, PowerShell and C# where appropriate, including test strategies for AI-enabled and streaming user journeys.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, applying quality gates, environment configuration and repeatable release practices.
Containerise applications and deploy to Azure services such as App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps or AKS, as appropriate.
Instrument applications with logs, metrics, traces and usage telemetry; diagnose production issues and participate in incident response and root-cause analysis.
Contribute to secure coding, accessibility, privacy, Responsible AI, architecture and engineering standards across the AI application portfolio.

Technical leadership and collaboration

Work closely with product owners and stakeholders to turn ambiguous business needs into measurable, testable software requirements and incremental delivery plans.
Provide technical direction through solution design, architecture discussions, code reviews and pragmatic trade-off decisions.
Mentor engineers in full-stack design, software quality, AI integration and production engineering practices.
Create reusable components, reference implementations and development patterns that help multiple AI teams deliver consistently.
Communicate technical risks, dependencies and options clearly to engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Experience

What we look for

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with evidence of senior-level ownership of production applications.
Strong hands-on experience building modern web applications with C#, Razor/Blazor, CSS and JavaScript on the front end, and C#/.NET back-end services.
Production experience with Razor/Blazor user interfaces, including component design, state management, CSS styling, JavaScript interoperability and front-end testing.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating front ends with distributed back-end services.
Hands-on experience delivering AI-enabled applications, such as generative AI, LLM, RAG, conversational AI, document intelligence or agent-based solutions.
Experience with Azure-hosted applications and automated delivery using Git and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to take software from design through deployment and operational support in an enterprise environment.
Experience creating automation and test tooling with TypeScript, PowerShell and C#.

Desired Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph or comparable orchestration frameworks.
Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure ML, Cosmos DB, Redis, PostgreSQL/pgvector or other vector-capable data services.
Experience with real-time communication and streaming technologies such as SignalR, Server-Sent Events or WebSockets.

Description

If you are looking for an opportunity to build innovative cloud-native solutions, work with AI/ML technologies, and make a direct impact on customers migrating to AWS, this might be the role for you.

Our team is responsible for the development of DMS Schema Conversion — the cloud-based service within AWS Database Migration Service that automatically assesses and converts database schemas, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and other database objects from commercial databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Sybase) to AWS-native targets such as Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, Amazon Aurora.

DMS Schema Conversion is an instrument for automatic conversion of database metadata to a format compatible with the target database or service located in the AWS cloud. We are actively integrating Generative AI capabilities to automate time-intensive conversion tasks, reducing manual effort for customers and accelerating their migration journey.

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you will tackle challenging distributed systems problems, design and build features that serve customers at scale across 29+ AWS regions, and contribute to the next generation of AI-powered migration tooling.

AWS DMS team is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain cloud-based solutions that accelerate database migrations to AWS
Build and enhance schema conversion engines that transform database objects, stored procedures, and application code across multiple source/target conversion pairs
Integrate Generative AI capabilities to automate complex code conversion tasks that previously required manual intervention
Architect and implement scalable microservices deployed across 29+ AWS regions
Collaborate closely with database engineers, front-end engineers, and product managers to deliver high-quality features
Analyze existing database architectures to determine optimal migration and conversion strategies
Mentor other engineers, conduct design reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices
Research and identify new opportunities for AWS to innovate on behalf of our customers
Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives

A day in the life

You will design, develop, and deliver features that enable customers to seamlessly migrate their database workloads to AWS.

You will drive architectural decisions, solve complex problems with innovative approaches, and deliver with limited guidance while raising the technical bar for the entire team.

You will work on complex challenges driving architectural decisions, code transformation, distributed systems, and Generative AI integration — all while operating at AWS scale.

Our team is a passionate, highly-motivated group of specialists across a variety of technologies working in a fast-paced environment.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

jobs.title: Innovation Engineer – Software & Applications
jobs.description:
Location:
Shannon, Co. Clare, Ireland
Reports To:
CTO
Job Type:
Full-Time, Permanent, Onsite

The Opportunity

Ei Electronics is a top three global brand in smoke and carbon monoxide sensing with a growing base of connected products and environmental sensing technology.
We are now asking ourselves what the next generation of life-safety technology will look like and investing deeply in frontier innovation. We want to explore that question by building, experimenting and turning new ideas into working technology.
We are looking for an ambitious and curious Applications Engineer to join our new Global Innovation Centre in Shannon. This is not a conventional software development role focused on maintaining existing applications or delivering incremental changes. It is an opportunity to work at the very early stages of innovation — exploring emerging technologies, developing prototypes and creating new digital capabilities that could shape the future of technology within the home.
You could be building a backend to collect data from a new sensor one week, developing a dashboard to turn that data into useful insights the next, and experimenting with AI, cloud technologies or a completely new user-facing application after that.
Some ideas will develop into future Ei products and services. Others may prove that a particular technology or approach doesn't work. Both are part of innovation.
We are looking for someone who enjoys building software, experimenting with technology and turning data and ideas into something people can actually use. The effective use of modern AI development tools will be a core part of this role, enabling ideas to be developed, tested and demonstrated much faster than through conventional development approaches.
What You'll Do

You will work within Ei's Innovation Centre on early-stage connected technologies and concepts, taking ideas from initial investigation through to functional prototypes and proof-of-concept systems.
Your work will include:
Exploring emerging software, IoT and connected technologies that could create new opportunities in life safety, sensing and the connected home.
Developing backend services and systems to collect, process, store and analyse data from products, sensors and connected devices.
Designing APIs and interfaces between connected products, cloud services and user-facing applications.
Developing intuitive dashboards, web applications and mobile experiences that turn product and sensor data into useful information and insights.
Using modern AI development tools extensively to accelerate software development, coding, testing, debugging and rapid prototyping.
Experimenting with cloud platforms, databases, data analytics, AI and machine learning.
Building customer facing rapid proof-of-concept systems to determine whether new ideas are technically viable and valuable.
Working with electronics, embedded and RF engineers to connect physical prototypes with digital platforms and applications.
Developing new technical concepts and contributing to the creation of new intellectual property and patents.
Collaborating with universities, technology partners and researchers and helping successful concepts progress towards future product development.

Who We're Looking For

We're more interested in curiosity, technical ability and ambition than finding someone who has already done exactly this job before.
You should be the kind of engineer or developer who wants to understand how things work, enjoys experimenting and is prepared to build something to test an idea rather than simply discuss whether it might work.
You will ideally have:
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronic & Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
Strong software development and programming skills.
Strong practical experience using modern AI development tools to accelerate application development.
An understanding of backend development, databases, APIs and modern application architectures.
Knowledge of cloud technologies and connected-product architectures.
An appreciation of UI/UX and the ability to make complex information simple and intuitive for users.
An understanding of cybersecurity and data protection principles for connected products.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with the confidence to investigate unfamiliar technologies and learn quickly.

Useful Experience

You don't need to have everything on this list. Experience or an interest in any of the following would be useful:
Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java or similar languages
Backend and full-stack development
SQL and NoSQL databases
REST APIs, WebSockets, MQTT and other IoT interfaces
Modern web frameworks such as React, Angular or Vue
Mobile application development for iOS or Android
Dashboard development, data visualisation and UI/UX
AWS, Azure, GCP or similar cloud platforms
IoT technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, Matter, Thread and LoRa/LoRaWAN
Data analytics, machine learning and AI
Cybersecurity for connected products
Rapid prototyping and taking a digital concept from initial idea to working demonstration

Experience

We are open to engineers and developers at different stages of their careers.
You may be a recent graduate with excellent technical ability and a portfolio of applications, projects or systems you've built yourself, or you may already have several years of industry experience and want the opportunity to move into a more exploratory and innovation-focused environment.
Above all, we are looking for someone who is technically curious, creative, ambitious and excited by the opportunity to create something that doesn't exist yet.
Why Join Ei's Innovation Centre?

Ei Electronics develops l technology used in homes around the world. Our Innovation Centre has been established to look beyond today's products and investigate the technologies and ideas that could define what comes next.
You'll have access to modern R&D laboratories, engineering equipment, connected-product technologies and the resources needed to turn ideas into real working prototypes.
Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to work on problems where the answer isn't already known.
We offer a competitive salary and bonus scheme, health benefits, professional development opportunities and the opportunity to help create technologies that could ultimately improve and protect people's lives.

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Creditsafe are expanding their Consumer Bureau team, an exciting new project aiming to have us enter the Consumer Credit Bureau space in the United Kingdom and eventually become a fully-fledged Consumer Reporting Agency. We’re looking for a Quality Engineer experienced in testing cloud-native software systems.

WHO WE ARE

Privately owned and independently minded, at Creditsafe, we are guided by values of customer-focus, trust, respect, and a willingness to try new things. For over 20 years, these values have shaped a culture of growth, innovation, and support, where our team members build successful, long-term careers.
With a diverse team spread across 25 offices in 14 countries, we value collaboration, learning, and problem-solving together. We have been featured twice in The Sunday Times' '100 Best Companies to Work For' and continue to prioritize well-being, career growth, and inclusion.
Our continued success has made us the most used business data provider in the world and one of the industry’s strongest growing business intelligence providers. Today Creditsafe has 23 offices across 3 continents serving 110,000 customers from SMEs to enterprise businesses.

THE TEAM

This opportunity is to join an Agile team of Software, Data and Quality engineers who are responsible for two - one productionized and one upcoming – big data projects. These projects process hundreds of GB a day in massive ELTL ingest, person-centric matching, and sub-second-serving batch and near-real-time processes.
The wider Quality Engineering community within Creditsafe work together in driving a culture of quality into the teams acting as knowledge experts on quality. We test throughout the lifecycle and believe that the whole team is responsible for the quality of our deliverables. We implement intelligent automation and are proponents of thinking critically about the features developed by our teams.

YOUR ROLE

You will validate data correctness across every layer of the stack: ingest, transformation, warehouse, and API. You will write SQL to interrogate millions of rows, build Python test suites that run against cloud infrastructure, and work directly with engineers and analyst to trace data issues from source to serving.
You will collaborate closely with our sister Data Analytics, and product teams, from the beginning stages of development, offering input on system design and testing strategies and ensuring our feature output matches their expectations and demands.
This is a hybrid position, requiring attendance in the office for 50% of the working week, in line with our hybrid work policy.

YOUR TOOL STACK

SQL. You'll write queries daily.
Python. PyTest, automation frameworks, data validation scripts
Pandas (or Spark/Polars). For dataset analysis and comparison.
AWS. Our stack includes Redshift, S3, S3Tables (Iceberg), DynamoDB, Aurora (Postgres), Step Functions, Airflow, Lambda, ECS, Glue, among others. You don't need to know all of them, but experience with any AWS data services (or equivalent in Azure or GCP) is a strong start.
API testing tools. Postman, Bruno, or similar.
Locust (or k6/Gatling/JMeter). For load and performance testing against data APIs and pipelines.
Git.
Azure DevOps. Boards, pipelines, repos, test plans.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Data Pipeline Testing: Build and maintain automated tests for data pipelines from ingest all the way until serving layer. Validate record counts, schema integrity, transformation logic, and cross-source consistency.
Data Validation: Verify correctness, completeness, and accuracy across Redshift, Aurora, S3, and DynamoDB. Trace individual records through the full pipeline when something doesn't add up.
API Testing: Test search and lookup APIs against expected data outcomes, not just status codes, but whether the right records come back with the right values.
Performance Testing: Design and run load tests against APIs and data pipelines using Locust or similar tools. Identify bottlenecks, validate SLAs, and ensure the system handles production-scale volumes.
Early Involvement: Join refinement sessions, challenge acceptance criteria and flag gaps before code is written.
Automation: Build test suites in PyTest that run in CI/CD. Integration tests against real AWS infrastructure, not just mocks.
Troubleshooting: When a pipeline produces wrong results, you find where and why. Clear reports, reproducible queries, root cause analysis.

We will support your learning and provide resources to help you grow in this role.
WHAT YOU BRING
Experience: Proven experience testing data systems, pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, not just web applications.
SQL: Good SQL skills. You can write joins, procs, and aggregations to validate data across tables.
Python: Good Python for test automation, scripting, and data analysis.
Cloud: Familiarity with AWS data services (Redshift, S3, DynamoDB, Aurora) or an equivalent cloud stack.
Analytical Mindset: You look at a dataset and spot what's wrong, not just confirm what's right.
Automation: Experience integrating test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Performance: Experience with performance and load testing tools (Locust, k6, Gatling, or similar) is desired.
Communication: Ability to explain data issues clearly to engineers and product owners.
Leadership: Experience mentoring junior engineers is a plus.

WHY CREDITSAFE
IC ladder with teeth. Staff and Principal are a destination, not a waypoint - with scope, comp and influence that genuinely match the title.
Written design culture. Anything non-trivial gets an RFC. Decisions are recorded. We disagree in documents, not in meetings.
Real operability. We run what we build. No hand-offs to a separate ops team.
Pragmatic agile. Teams own their own process. We optimise for shipping, not ceremony.
Customer-first. Our focus is on making work that adds value to our clients first. Stability, freshness, durability, trust – non-negotiable.
Leadership you’ll want to work with. Engineering leadership is technical, present, and will back your calls.

Benefits
Competitive Salary.
Company Laptop
Bonus Scheme.
25 Days Annual Leave (plus bank holidays).
Hybrid working model.
Healthcare & Company Pension.

We are committed to providing a welcoming, supportive environment. Creditsafe is an equal opportunities employer that values diversity. Please contact us if you need any assistance with your application.

As a Full-Stack Developer at Atea, you will develop and improve business-critical applications using C#/.NET, React and TypeScript. You will join an international product team and work closely with developers, Product Owners and other stakeholders across several European locations.

You will have meaningful technical responsibility, but you will not be expected to solve everything alone. You will have skilled colleagues around you who share knowledge, challenge ideas and work together to build software that creates real value for its users.

About The Role

You will contribute to products within the team’s portfolio, currently including solutions such as Zoom and Cloud Reports. The product scope may develop over time and could also include Application Manager Online.

Regardless of the product you work on, you will be part of the same international team and technical environment. You will contribute throughout the development process, from understanding requirements and discussing technical solutions to development, testing and continuous improvement.

The team works according to Agile principles, with security, maintainability and business value as important parts of the development process.

AI-assisted development is also part of how we work. We are looking for someone who can use AI tools thoughtfully and effectively while maintaining good engineering judgment and high standards for security and quality.

What You Will Do

In this role, you will:

Develop and maintain full-stack features using C#/.NET, APIs, React, TypeScript and JavaScript, based on product and business requirements.
Contribute to architecture and engineering quality by applying secure development principles, established design patterns and SOLID practices, as well as conducting code reviews and writing maintainable unit tests.
Improve the performance, availability and maintainability of our applications through troubleshooting, technical analysis and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with Product Owners, developers and stakeholders across locations, share knowledge within the team and use AI-assisted workflows to support development, testing and problem-solving.

Who We Think Will Thrive In This Role

You will probably enjoy this role if you like combining hands-on development with technical problem-solving and collaboration.

You take responsibility for your work and communicate clearly when requirements, priorities or technical decisions need to be discussed. You care about building solutions that are secure, stable and maintainable, while remaining curious about new technologies and better ways of working.

Because the team is distributed across several countries, you should be comfortable collaborating digitally and communicating with colleagues from different professional and cultural backgrounds.

What We Believe You Need From Day One

We believe the following experience is important for succeeding in the role:

At least four years of professional software development experience
Strong experience with C# and .NET, including API development
Practical experience with React, TypeScript and JavaScript
Experience working with Microsoft SQL databases
Experience with unit testing and writing maintainable tests
A good understanding of secure software development and SOLID principles
Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken, at approximately B2 level or above

Relevant professional experience may compensate for formal IT education.

It is an advantage if you also have

It would be useful, but not essential, if you have experience with:

Microsoft Azure, including Function Apps, Storage, App Service or Key Vault
Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines
Cloud cost awareness and Azure cost optimisation
Mentoring or supporting other developers
Agile product development in an international or distributed team

What You Can Learn After Joining

You do not need to know every product, internal tool or Azure service from your first day.

You Will Have The Opportunity To Learn:

The products and business areas supported by the team
The team’s architecture, development processes and internal tools
Additional Azure services relevant to the product portfolio
How the team uses AI-assisted workflows in development, testing and problem-solving

Your curiosity, willingness to share knowledge and ability to learn are more important than being able to check every box.

What You Can Expect From Us

At Atea, you will join an international and welcoming working environment where collaboration and knowledge sharing are part of everyday work.

We Offer:

A technically varied full-stack role across backend and frontend development
An international product team with skilled colleagues across several European locations
Opportunities to influence technical solutions, architecture and engineering practices
Training and development opportunities tailored to your professional goals
Access to company-sponsored certifications and relevant learning activities
A hybrid working model based on the role, location and business needs
An inclusive environment with professional and social meeting places
Local employment benefits based on whether you are employed in Norway or Latvia

We believe strong software is built by people who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other improve. You will receive responsibility and room to contribute, with a team around you when the problems become difficult.

A Little About Atea

Atea works with technology that supports organisations and the people who depend on it. Behind every reliable solution are people who develop, test, improve and support it together.

As part of Atea, you will join a wider professional community with opportunities to learn, share experience and develop your skills. We believe in giving people responsibility while making sure they have colleagues and expertise around them.

Practical information

Position type: Full-time
Location: Drammen, Norway or Riga, Latvia
Working model: Hybrid
Working language: Norwegian and English
Application deadline: 18.10.26
Contact person: Margarita Scerbakova
Job role: Developer

Interested?

If you would like to build secure and reliable software with an international team, we would be happy to hear from you.

You may not meet every preferred qualification listed above, and that is okay. If you have strong experience with the core technology stack, enjoy collaborative product development and are motivated to learn, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
About Oliasoft:

Oliasoft develops cloud-native engineering software for designing, planning and constructing wells for oil and gas, carbon capture and storage (CCS) and geothermal energy.

Our first product, Oliasoft WellDesign, was launched in 2020. By automating time-consuming work processes and combining AI with advanced, physics-based simulations in areas such as thermodynamics and fluid mechanics, we make well planning more efficient and more accurate.

Following several commercial and technological breakthroughs, we are now entering a new phase of growth. Interest in our solutions is strong, with customers such as Equinor, Vår Energi, Harbour, and Tullow, and we are expanding the platform to serve a growing international customer base. That's why we're building the team that will take Oliasoft to the next level.

Who we are:

The team consists of highly skilled employees with knowledge from software development, math, physics and the oil and gas industry. The common denominator is a passion for innovation and a desire to deliver high quality products.

Our work environment is characterized by dedicated professionals, cooperation, curiosity and discussions related to providing value to our customers. We are constantly evolving through challenging work tasks and are given great freedom in how we want to solve them.

Our Customer Success department is responsible for ensuring that our customers achieve their desired outcomes with Oliasoft products. We work tightly with the Marketing, Sales and Product teams to provide insights from our customers to the rest of the organisation. We are now looking for a Solutions Engineer for our Oslo team. The Solutions Engineer combines well engineering domain expertise with strong technical aptitude to support customers across the full lifecycle of the Oliasoft WellDesign platform. We provide comprehensive training in the platform, enabling you to manage everything from technical evaluation during the sales process through onboarding, training, and ongoing technical support that drives adoption, retention and expansion. The position reports to the Head of Customer Success in Oslo and involves approximately 20–30% travel to customer sites, workshops and industry conferences.

As a Solutions Engineer at Oliasoft you will:

Present live WellDesign demonstrations – from consultative sessions with individual engineers to VP-level technical evaluations – translating platform capabilities into concrete engineering value

Partner with Sales to run technical discovery calls, proof-of-concept and pilot engagements with prospective customers

Represent Oliasoft at industry conferences and technical workshops, presenting to broader technical audiences

Translate customer well engineering requirements and workflows into effective WellDesign configurations and technical solutions

Respond to technical sections of RFPs and RFIs, and lead technical workshops with prospect engineering teams

Contribute to onboarding and training for new customers, ensuring continuity from evaluation through to daily use

Deliver technical support to customers using our established support systems

Support renewal conversations with technical evidence of the value delivered

Contribute to best-practice guides, training and sales enablement material

To succeed in this role you should have:

Confidence in holding presentations, demonstrations and customer workshops, for both technical and commercial audiences

Solid grounding in well engineering fundamentals: casing design, drilling mechanics, trajectory design

Relevant work experience from Oil & Gas, for example Drilling Engineering, Well Planning, Completion Engineering or oilfield technical software (design, application engineering or field engineering)

Bachelors or Masters degree in a relevant engineering discipline (petroleum, drilling, mechanical or chemical), or equivalent practical experience

Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills, and the ability to communicate with engineers and commercial stakeholders alike

The ability to keep calm when working under pressure and deliver on promise

The ability to communicate fluently in English, both written and verbal

Willingness to travel regionally and internationally

A valid work permit for Norway

Previous experience in pre-sales or technical support, fluency in additional European languages, and knowledge of Oliasoft WellDesign and Forecast are advantages, but not requirements, for the position.

What we offer:

The opportunity to participate in one of the most interesting Norwegian software companies creating revolutionary software for the oil industry

Highly proactive and creative colleagues that are passionate about technology, programming and engineering, wanting to build the best product possible

Opportunity to make a difference – both for the industry but also in the company

Minimal bureaucracy and leadership levels, so that we can make fast decisions and be customer oriented

Small team - possibility to really make an impact and with good opportunity to further develop your skills

Open, friendly, diverse and relaxed working environment

Competitive compensation and flexible workhours

Apply now and before 23 October!

For more information contact Julie on
julie.jacobsen@oliasoft.com

jobs.title: Azure Developer
jobs.description:
HiQ:lla missiomme on yksinkertaistaa ihmisten elämää. Syvän ja monipuolisen teknologia- ja toimialaosaamisemme sekä luovan ajattelun avulla taklaamme asiakkaidemme haasteita ja luomme entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja. HiQ:lla rakennetaan aidosti arvokkaita palveluita asiakkaille. Meillä pääset rakentamaan yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviä palveluita, asiakkaiden tarpeet täyttäviä end-to-end -ratkaisuja, kriittisiä taustajärjestelmiä ja meidän kaikkien käyttämiä kuluttajapalveluita. Haluamme olla ylpeitä työstämme, ja pyrimmekin aina parhaimpaamme. Siitä tulee nimemmekin, HiQ, High Quality.

Mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen?

Se on mielenkiintoisia projekteja, afterwork-kaljoja, uuden oppimista ja toinen toisemme tukemista. Työkavereita, joista tulee aitoja ystäviä. Lapset saa lähteä hakemaan kotiin etuajassa ja välillä taas puristetaan loppukiri porukalla. Haluamme olla yhteisö, jossa haluat olla vuodesta toiseen. Paikka, jossa voit kehittyä työnantajaa vaihtamatta. Jokainen meistä vaikuttaa siihen, mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen.

Roolisi Azure-kehittäjänä

Etsimme suomen ja englannin kielen taitoisia Azure-kehittäjiä erityisesti finanssisektorin asiakasprojekteihimme. Toivomme, että sinulla on useamman vuoden (+5) kokemus vaativista ohjelmistokehitysprojekteista sekä vahvaa osaamista useammasta eri teknologiasta. Tehtävässä pääset suunnittelemaan ja kehittämään ratkaisuja Azure-pilvipalveluihin painottuen yhdessä ketterän kehitystiimin kanssa.

Tyypillisesti projekteissa odotetaan:
Vähintään 5 vuoden kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä
Usean vuoden kokemusta Azuren (tai AWS:n) palvelujen hyödyntämisestä
Backend-ohjelmointiosaamista esimerkiksi Javasta tai Pythonista
Osaamista REST API -rajapinnoista, Gitistä ja SQL-tietokannoista
Kokemusta tai halua hyödyntää AI-työkaluja, kuten GitHub Copilotia, Claudea tai ChatGPT:tä, oman työn tukena
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:
Kokemus data-alustaratkaisuista
Integraatio- ja data-arkkitehtuuriin liittyvä osaaminen
Taustaa CI/CD:stä sekä DevOps-työskentelystä
Tietoturvan ymmärrys
Aiempi kokemus finanssialalta

Arvostamme kiinnostusta uusien teknologioiden opiskeluun ja haltuunottoon sekä oman osaamisen jakamista muille kehittäjille. Omaat itseohjautuvan otteen ja olet toisia huomioiva tiimipelaaja.

Tehtävässä työskennellään hybridimallilla: viikko jakautuu tyypillisesti asiakkaan tiloissa työskentelyyn pääkaupunkiseudulla (n. 2–3 pv/vko) ja etätyöhön. Huomioithan, että työskentely finanssialan asiakkuudessa vaatii turvallisuusselvityksen sekä mm. luottotietojen tarkistuksen.

Hae nyt

Mikäli tunnistit itsesi edellä mainituista kohdista, kuulisimme erittäin mielellämme sinusta lisää! Voit laittaa hakemuksesi linkin kautta. Jos sinulla heräsi kysymyksiä meidän suuntaan, voit olla yhteydessä Elina Haapamäkeen ( elina.haapamaki@hiq.fi
)

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning AI possibilities into scalable real-world solutions? We do.

We’re looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join Vincit and help our customers turn AI from hype into real business value.

In this role, you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong business mindset, working across software development, AI architecture, and customer collaboration. You’ll help customers identify where AI creates real value and design solutions that are both technically solid and commercially meaningful.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the code while also helping customers and teams make the right technical and architectural decisions. You’ll work closely with clients, designers, software engineers, and data experts to shape AI solutions that scale beyond proof-of-concepts and deliver measurable impact.

You know you’ve succeeded when customers clearly understand the value of AI, solutions make it into production, and your work creates meaningful outcomes for both the business and its users.

What is the job like, really?

Our customer base and projects are broad and diverse, ranging from startups to globally operating enterprises, and from early-stage AI experiments to large-scale production solutions. You'll work in both advisory-focused engagements and hands-on delivery projects where Vincit takes full responsibility for the solution.

Here’s a Snapshot Of Your Key Responsibilities

☘️ Building AI solutions –
designing and implementing production-grade AI applications, integrations, and agentic workflows together with development teams

☘️ Acting as a technical lead –
ensuring technical quality, clarity, and scalability throughout the delivery lifecycle

☘️ Designing scalable architectures –
creating technical blueprints and solution architectures for modern AI and cloud-native applications

☘️ Consulting customers on AI opportunities
– helping clients identify where AI can create genuine business value

☘️ Leading discovery and proof-of-concepts
– facilitating workshops, technical discovery sessions, and validating new ideas quickly

☘️ Supporting sales and business development
– shaping proposals and acting as a trusted technical expert in customer discussions

☘️ Translating complexity into business value
– communicating AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences

☘️ Sharing knowledge and mentoring others
– supporting colleagues across engineering, design, and data disciplines

What are we looking for? 🔍

You’ll do well in this role if you enjoy solving real business problems with technology. You’re comfortable moving between hands-on development, architectural thinking, and customer discussions, and you know how to translate technical possibilities into practical outcomes.

You’re also curious by nature and excited to keep learning – whether that means experimenting with the latest AI capabilities, exploring new cloud services, or finding better ways to build scalable AI solutions.

Your background

🎯 Strong software engineering background, ideally in web development, cloud-native applications, or distributed systems

🎯 Strong experience designing and building AI-powered applications or solutions

🎯 Experience with modern agentic AI patterns, workflows, and development practices

🎯 Experience working with customer-facing projects or consultancy environments

🎯 Strong understanding of cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and their AI capabilities

🎯 Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, or similar technologies

🎯 Ability to combine technical expertise with business understanding

🎯 Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences

🎯 Full professional proficiency in Finnish

It’s a Strong Plus If You Have

🎯 Experience bringing AI or agentic AI solutions from proof-of-concept into production

🎯 Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, or other modern AI platforms

🎯 Certifications in Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud technologies

What's in it for you?

As a 500-person company, we combine the support and career opportunities of a larger organization with the agility and low hierarchy of a smaller one. This gives you both the structure to succeed and the freedom to shape how things are done – together with a supportive community around you.

Here are a few more reasons why Vincit is worth considering:

🌟 Variety and impact in projects –
from smaller implementations to large business transformations, often involving real business change, not just system implementations.

🌟 AI at the core –
work with modern AI tools in your daily work, deepen your expertise, and contribute to building AI-driven solutions. In 2026, we became the first company in Finland to receive the ISO/IEC 42001 certification for our AI management system.

🌟 Strong partner ecosystem –
as a Microsoft Solutions Partner and SAP Gold Partner, we work closely with leading technology providers, giving you access to high-quality projects and deep expertise.

🌟 Trusted and responsible way of working –
our EcoVadis assessment and ISO certifications ensure high-quality, secure, and responsible delivery for our customers.

And what else do you get as a Vincitizen?

🌟 Flexibility & work-life balance –
shape your work around your life, whether it’s family, hobbies, or something else important to you, while also making use of our top-notch office spaces in an award-winning workplace

🌟 Solid pay –
your monthly base salary reflects your experience and expertise. In addition, you’ll benefit from Vincit’s bonus model, personnel fund, and transparent salary weeks

🌟 Comprehensive benefits –
including lunch benefit, healthcare and dental services, insurance, childcare services, high-quality equipment, and more

🌟 Growth & career opportunities –
develop your skills through Univincity and shape your path toward new roles, specializations, or directions. Read inspiring examples of career paths in our career stories.

🌟 Active communities –
a transparent and humane organization where people connect, collaborate, and have fun together. It’s where our belief, “extraordinary things are created together”, comes to life – and one of the reasons we’re an award-winning workplace.

🌟 Commitment to inclusion –
we believe in a more inclusive digital world and strive to create a safe, welcoming welcoming workplace for everyone

👉 Explore real-life examples of our human-centric culture in our
People & Culture blog
and learn more about how we work in our
Code of Conduct

Curious but still on the fence?

If you’d like to learn more about the role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at careers@vincit.com.

To get to know us as an employer, we recommend checking our career site, blog, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. You might also like our post about Vincit’s candidate-friendly recruitment process.

P.S. Please note that if you live abroad and want to work with us, we need you to have the necessary permits for working in Finland.

At Vincit, we turn digital into business results by combining leading enterprise platforms, AI solutions, and human-centric design. We help our customers make the most of SAP, Microsoft Azure, and other cloud ecosystems, embedding AI capabilities across their business operations and services.

We believe that extraordinary things are created together. That’s why we’re on a mission to create better Mondays – for our people, our clients, and our planet. Join us and become part of a community of top professionals across different areas of IT, united by curiosity, empathy, and a drive to build things that truly matter.

jobs.title: Solution Area Architect (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Etsimme Solution Area Architectia!

Solution Area Architectina
vastaat Elisan toimittamisen, talouden ja tukiprosessien sovellusalueiden arkkitehtuurista ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet liiketoiminnan, IT:n ja toimittajien rajapinnassa varmistaen, että järjestelmät, integraatiot ja toimintamallit tukevat liiketoiminnan tavoitteita sekä tulevaisuuden tarpeita.

Liityt 10 hengen asiantuntijatiimiin, joka vastaa näiden sovellusalueiden kehityksestä. Roolissasi ohjaat kehityskokonaisuuksia, osallistut kehityshankkeisiin ja edistät uusien ratkaisujen käyttöönottoa yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Samalla tuot uusia näkökulmia ja teknologiamahdollisuuksia liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.

✅ Odotamme Sinulta

Taustaa ratkaisu- tai integraatioarkkitehdin tehtävistä sekä kykyä IT-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen.
Näyttöjä ERP-ratkaisujen uudistamis-, käyttöönotto- tai transformaatiohankkeista.
Ymmärrystä talous- ja toimitusketjun hallinnan prosesseista sekä niiden kehittämisestä.
Osaamista ERP-järjestelmistä, erityisesti SAP S/4HANA- tai Microsoft Dynamics 365 -ympäristöistä ja niiden keskeisistä integraatioista.
Kyky toimia tehokkaasti liiketoiminnan, IT:n, toimittajien ja muiden sidosryhmien välisenä yhteistyön mahdollistajana.
IT-järjestelmien ylläpidon prosessit, mukaan lukien järjestelmien budjetointi, elinkaaren hallinta ja tietoturva.
Ymmärrät tekoälyn hyödyntämismahdollisuudet järjestelmien, prosessien ja operatiivisen toiminnan kehittämisessä.
Alempaa korkeakoulututkintoa tietotekniikan alalta tai vastaavaa osaamista hankittuna työkokemuksen kautta.
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

💡 Lisäksi Arvostamme, Jos Sinulla On Kokemusta

Sovellusarkkitehtuurien kehittämisestä mikropalveluarkkitehtuureilla.
API-rajapinnoista ja niiden hallinnasta. Erityisesti arvostamme TM Forum Open API -rajapintojen ja TM Forum -tietomallien tuntemusta.
Pilvipohjaisista integraatio- ja kehitysalustoista, kuten Azure Integration Services-, SAP BTP- tai vastaavista ratkaisuista.
Tietoliikennealan liiketoimintaprosesseista ja järjestelmäympäristöistä.

Emme odota, että täytät kaikki vaatimukset täydellisesti. Jos tunnistat itsesi roolin keskeisistä osaamisista ja sinulla on motivaatio kasvaa tehtävässä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

💙
Tervetuloa joukkoomme!

Tässä tehtävässä saat mukavat ja osaavat työkaverit, kiinnostavat ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät, ja pääset kehittämään sovelluksia ja työkaluja, joilla on aidosti vaikutusta sekä meidän elisalaisten että asiakkaidemme sujuvaan arkeen. Henkilökohtaista kehittymistäsi tuetaan ja pääset myös tiimin mukana kehittämään toimintamallejamme jatkuvan parantamisen hengessä.

Toimipisteesi voi sijaita Helsingissä Pasilassa tai vaihtoehtoisesti jossain muussa Elisan toimipisteessä Suomessa

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Unified Platform
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Team

The Unified Privacy Platform team’s mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Our work is organized around three connected pillars: the Privacy Center, a unified user-facing destination for privacy controls and rights; the Unified Privacy Platform, which captures and enforces consent, policy, jurisdictional requirements, and privacy actions; and Privacy Operations and Intelligence, which gives Legal, Support, Privacy, and engineering operators the workflows, diagnostics, audit history, and automation needed to resolve privacy work safely and efficiently.

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

About The Role

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. You will lead a team of backend and platform engineers responsible for the next generation of privacy and consent infrastructure, including the Privacy Center, the User Consent Platform, privacy-policy decisioning, self-service data-rights experiences, and the operational tooling required to manage privacy cases at global scale.

As the Engineering Manager, you will own and execute a multi-year vision for privacy at DoorDash. You will balance legal and regulatory correctness, user trust, security, reliability, and developer velocity while building systems that work consistently across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will be a strategic partner to Product, Legal, Security, Data Governance, Marketing and Communications, and engineering leadership, establishing clear ownership boundaries and turning complex privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, privacy by design, operational excellence, and thoughtful cross-functional partnership
Drive the technical strategy across the Privacy Center, the Unified Privacy Platform, and Privacy Operations and Intelligence
Build the cross-brand User Consent Platform, including canonical consent state, policy and configuration management, consent SDKs, audit history, and consistent enforcement across products and jurisdictions
Deliver simple, self-service experiences for consent and communication preferences, Right to be Forgotten (RTF), Right to Information (RTI), and Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs)
Turn emerging privacy and regulatory requirements into standardized platform capabilities instead of one-off product implementations
Lead the migration from fragmented legacy consent systems to a single source of truth across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, while managing compatibility and safe deprecation
Define clear contracts with data-governance fulfillment systems and downstream product and storage teams so privacy actions are traceable, retryable, auditable, and correctly reflected back to users and operators
Provide architectural guidance for distributed systems that manage sensitive user choices, policy evaluation, orchestration, secure data delivery, reporting, and immutable audit trails
Partner with recruiting to build a diverse and inclusive team, attracting and retaining exceptional engineering talent

We’re excited about you because you have…

A bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
3+ years of experience in people management leading backend or platform teams
8+ years of industry experience
Extensive experience as an engineer or engineering leader in a fast-paced, platform-focused development environment
Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems, service application programming interfaces (APIs), policy or rules engines, workflow orchestration, state machines, data-lifecycle systems, or audit architectures
Preferred experience with privacy, consent, data governance, or regulatory systems, including concepts such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), data-subject rights, retention, deletion, and legal holds
The ability to translate ambiguous legal, policy, and product requirements into clear platform boundaries, reusable abstractions, and executable roadmaps
Strong product sense and the ability to partner effectively with Legal, Product, Design, Security, Data, Marketing, Support, and engineering teams across multiple brands and geographies
A growth mindset—you are eager to expand your skills, raise the quality bar, and build enduring systems in a rapidly changing environment

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .
