jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to build advanced AI agents that solve real business problems, not just prototypes? Are you excited by combining software engineering and AI into production-ready solutions?

As we grow our Data & AI practice in Finland, we are looking for AI Engineers to strengthen our technical capabilities and help deliver innovative solutions for our clients. Building on our successful project delivery, we are expanding our team and welcome applications from both early-career and experienced professionals.

You will join a global Data, Analytics & AI community helping leading organizations turn data into business value through data strategy, engineering, advanced analytics, AI, and intelligent automation.

About The Role

You thrive at the intersection of software engineering, business, and AI. You enjoy building modern applications and turning emerging technologies into production-ready solutions that create business value. You are equally comfortable understanding client needs and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

In This Role, You Will, For Example

Build, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications, AI agents, and cloud-native solutions
Design scalable architectures and integrate applications across frontend, backend, cloud, and enterprise environments
Develop intelligent software solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, MCP, and agentic AI capabilities
Work directly with clients to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions
Identify and help shape opportunities where AI can create measurable business value for clients
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver end-to-end solutions from concept to production
Present technical solutions and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders

The exact focus and responsibilities of the role will be tailored to your experience level and interests.

We Are Looking For

Background in software engineering through professional experience, studies, and/or personal projects, with experience or a strong interest in building software solutions
Experience in working across frontend, backend, and cloud environments
Experience in designing, integrating, and consuming APIs
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS) and infrastructure-as-code concepts
Exposure to Generative AI, LLM-based applications, or related AI technologies
Curiosity and a desire to continuously learn and experiment
Fluent communication skills in English (written and spoken), preferably also in Finnish and/or Swedish

Nice-to-have Qualifications Include

Hands-on experience with LLMs, reasoning models, AI agents, RAG, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph
Experience in building reliable AI agent workflows, including tool use, function calling, validation, and human-in-the-loop processes
Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, and tracing
Knowledge of AI governance, security, guardrails, and responsible AI practices
Experience working with clients and stakeholders, ideally in a consulting environment

What We Offer You

Steep learning curve & interesting projects: We combine deep technology expertise with strong functional and industry knowledge. You’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GenAI technologies and modern cloud platforms, helping clients solve complex business challenges. From designing AI agents to integrating LLM-powered capabilities into enterprise solutions, you will turn emerging technologies into measurable business value.
Personal & professional growth: We invest in our people. We support the development of your personal competencies and long-term career progression through regular development discussions, formal training, and hands-on project work.
Flexible work culture: We have a people-oriented culture where your work-life balance is supported with flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities. Our office located in the center of Helsinki provides a modern and comfortable working space when you work on-site.
Competitive compensation & benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package, including a performance-based bonus, coupled with a wide range of benefits.
Great team spirit: We focus on teaming also outside of project work through a variety of after-work activities and events together with your colleagues. We look forward to welcoming you to our collaborative and supportive team.

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer. For us, diversity and inclusion are an important part of our employment proposition. We want everyone to fulfill their potential and be themselves, regardless of background. To learn more about us and our culture, you can check out our video and visit www.bearingpoint.com. You can also follow our latest news and daily life on Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and blog.   

If this sounds like the next step in your career, join us!

We look forward to receiving your application by October 25th
. Please note that we will review applications and start interviews before the deadline. This is a permanent full-time position based in Helsinki.

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in three business units: Consulting, Products, and Capital. Consulting covers the advisory business with a clear focus on selected business areas. Products provides IP-driven digital assets and managed services for business-critical processes. Capital delivers M&A and transaction services. BearingPoint’s clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. The firm has a global consulting network with more than 13,000 people and supports clients in over 70 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success. In Finland, we are focusing on Consulting and are located in the heart of Helsinki where our around 100 employees are based.  

We are guided by our purpose – Together, we are more than business.

It revolves around three key focus areas – More innovation, More for our planet, and More for our people. To make sure we live that purpose, we’re steered by a set of values that bring our purpose to life and are the essence of our culture – We are easy to work with, We create lasting outcomes, We empower people to succeed. We are a strongly purpose & values-driven organization, both today and as we forge our way into the future. Learn more about our purpose and values here.

BearingPoint is a certified B Corporation, meeting high standards of social and environmental impact.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning AI possibilities into scalable real-world solutions? We do.

We’re looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join Vincit and help our customers turn AI from hype into real business value.

In this role, you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong business mindset, working across software development, AI architecture, and customer collaboration. You’ll help customers identify where AI creates real value and design solutions that are both technically solid and commercially meaningful.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the code while also helping customers and teams make the right technical and architectural decisions. You’ll work closely with clients, designers, software engineers, and data experts to shape AI solutions that scale beyond proof-of-concepts and deliver measurable impact.

You know you’ve succeeded when customers clearly understand the value of AI, solutions make it into production, and your work creates meaningful outcomes for both the business and its users.

What is the job like, really?

Our customer base and projects are broad and diverse, ranging from startups to globally operating enterprises, and from early-stage AI experiments to large-scale production solutions. You'll work in both advisory-focused engagements and hands-on delivery projects where Vincit takes full responsibility for the solution.

Here’s a Snapshot Of Your Key Responsibilities

☘️ Building AI solutions –
designing and implementing production-grade AI applications, integrations, and agentic workflows together with development teams

☘️ Acting as a technical lead –
ensuring technical quality, clarity, and scalability throughout the delivery lifecycle

☘️ Designing scalable architectures –
creating technical blueprints and solution architectures for modern AI and cloud-native applications

☘️ Consulting customers on AI opportunities
– helping clients identify where AI can create genuine business value

☘️ Leading discovery and proof-of-concepts
– facilitating workshops, technical discovery sessions, and validating new ideas quickly

☘️ Supporting sales and business development
– shaping proposals and acting as a trusted technical expert in customer discussions

☘️ Translating complexity into business value
– communicating AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences

☘️ Sharing knowledge and mentoring others
– supporting colleagues across engineering, design, and data disciplines

What are we looking for? 🔍

You’ll do well in this role if you enjoy solving real business problems with technology. You’re comfortable moving between hands-on development, architectural thinking, and customer discussions, and you know how to translate technical possibilities into practical outcomes.

You’re also curious by nature and excited to keep learning – whether that means experimenting with the latest AI capabilities, exploring new cloud services, or finding better ways to build scalable AI solutions.

Your background

🎯 Strong software engineering background, ideally in web development, cloud-native applications, or distributed systems

🎯 Strong experience designing and building AI-powered applications or solutions

🎯 Experience with modern agentic AI patterns, workflows, and development practices

🎯 Experience working with customer-facing projects or consultancy environments

🎯 Strong understanding of cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and their AI capabilities

🎯 Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, or similar technologies

🎯 Ability to combine technical expertise with business understanding

🎯 Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences

🎯 Full professional proficiency in Finnish

It’s a Strong Plus If You Have

🎯 Experience bringing AI or agentic AI solutions from proof-of-concept into production

🎯 Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, or other modern AI platforms

🎯 Certifications in Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud technologies

What's in it for you?

As a 500-person company, we combine the support and career opportunities of a larger organization with the agility and low hierarchy of a smaller one. This gives you both the structure to succeed and the freedom to shape how things are done – together with a supportive community around you.

Here are a few more reasons why Vincit is worth considering:

🌟 Variety and impact in projects –
from smaller implementations to large business transformations, often involving real business change, not just system implementations.

🌟 AI at the core –
work with modern AI tools in your daily work, deepen your expertise, and contribute to building AI-driven solutions. In 2026, we became the first company in Finland to receive the ISO/IEC 42001 certification for our AI management system.

🌟 Strong partner ecosystem –
as a Microsoft Solutions Partner and SAP Gold Partner, we work closely with leading technology providers, giving you access to high-quality projects and deep expertise.

🌟 Trusted and responsible way of working –
our EcoVadis assessment and ISO certifications ensure high-quality, secure, and responsible delivery for our customers.

And what else do you get as a Vincitizen?

🌟 Flexibility & work-life balance –
shape your work around your life, whether it’s family, hobbies, or something else important to you, while also making use of our top-notch office spaces in an award-winning workplace

🌟 Solid pay –
your monthly base salary reflects your experience and expertise. In addition, you’ll benefit from Vincit’s bonus model, personnel fund, and transparent salary weeks

🌟 Comprehensive benefits –
including lunch benefit, healthcare and dental services, insurance, childcare services, high-quality equipment, and more

🌟 Growth & career opportunities –
develop your skills through Univincity and shape your path toward new roles, specializations, or directions. Read inspiring examples of career paths in our career stories.

🌟 Active communities –
a transparent and humane organization where people connect, collaborate, and have fun together. It’s where our belief, “extraordinary things are created together”, comes to life – and one of the reasons we’re an award-winning workplace.

🌟 Commitment to inclusion –
we believe in a more inclusive digital world and strive to create a safe, welcoming welcoming workplace for everyone

👉 Explore real-life examples of our human-centric culture in our
People & Culture blog
and learn more about how we work in our
Code of Conduct

Curious but still on the fence?

If you’d like to learn more about the role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at careers@vincit.com.

To get to know us as an employer, we recommend checking our career site, blog, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. You might also like our post about Vincit’s candidate-friendly recruitment process.

P.S. Please note that if you live abroad and want to work with us, we need you to have the necessary permits for working in Finland.

The successful candidate will establish architecture patterns, integration models, information structures and governance frameworks that enable trusted information exchange across multiple CDE, BIM, project delivery and enterprise platforms. This is not a traditional enterprise architect role: the architect must understand that the product is not merely software, but the lifecycle of project and asset information across organisations, systems and delivery stages.

Platform architecture: Design reusable patterns for document management, BIM coordination, workflows, collaboration, issue management, approvals, partner onboarding, information exchange and digital handover.

Collaborate with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, cloud and platform engineering teams to ensure solution designs align with enterprise principles and controls.

At least 8 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, platform architecture or large-scale systems integration.

Strong understanding of solution, enterprise, information, integration and platform architecture principles, including cloud-native application design.

Analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Experience with Git or similar version control systems.

ISTQB certification.

Strong working knowledge of relational and non-relational database systems — particularly PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redis.

Demonstrated track record of mentoring other engineers and leading technical design initiatives.

Experience with search and analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch.
Experience with RPC frameworks like Thrift or gRPC for low-latency service-to-service communication.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation).

Experience with high-throughput event-driven architectures or streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, SQS).

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Python, STC & Networking)
jobs.description:
Project description - VR-125264

Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.

Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.

Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.

Responsibilities

Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.

Skills

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Python, STC & Networking)
jobs.description:
Project description - VR-125264

Project Description: Product verification & testing for an L1-L3 Traffic Generator Solution for a Global Networking Testing and Validation equipment provider.

Our team: A team of networking enthusiasts willing to contribute to customer success.

Technologies used: Networking protocols, traffic generation tools, Windows/Linux servers, network virtualization, network management tools, microservices.

Opportunities: Networking and testing certifications, collaboration with an international team of professionals, working with the latest networking technologies and concepts, access to training.

Responsibilities

Design, implement and maintain long-running automated test scenarios (soak tests spanning days/weeks) using Spirent TestCenter APIs, covering performance, scalability, convergence, and protocol stability under sustained traffic load.
Derive automation requirements from manual functional test specifications and hardware validation reports
Collaborate with development team to translate software requirements into high-quality test automation suites
Develop automation for the end-to-end solution validation and integrate the automation for seamless validation.
Implement, execute and debug Python automated test scripts on Linux-based platforms
Analyze and manage automated regression test execution failures
Debug and troubleshoot complex issues and work closely with the engineering team on the failures and validate the fixes
Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate closely with hardware and software development teams to triage test failures and drive quality improvements
Reproduce and root-cause hardware/firmware defects through systematic test isolation
Make use of AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code, agentic AI) given customer-specific heavy usage patterns.
Review customer deployments and customer-found issues and address any gaps in the test coverage.

Skills

o Overall QA background of 6+ years, with 4+ years in testing networking domain-related applications.
o QA Automation experience in an Agile/SCRUM team, focused on API and/or CLI testing (4+ years);
Python strongly preferred (other comparable languages considered).
o Automated Testing for API or CLI 4+ years, including experience in test harness or framework
development.
o Hands-on experience automating Spirent TestCenter (STC) using its Python API — specifically StcPython
native API, the REST-based stcrestclient library (py-stcrestclient), or HLTAPI (High Level Test API); ability
to script traffic port configuration, device emulation, traffic stream setup, result subscription and statistics
retrieval.
o Familiarity with STC Lab Server architecture: connecting to chassis, managing test sessions, and
executing automated sequences without GUI dependency.
o Experience writing and maintaining long-running automation suites (soak tests of days/weeks duration)
with robust result collection, error handling, and reporting.
o Working knowledge of L2/L3 protocols exercised through STC: Ethernet, VLAN/QinQ, BGP (v4/v6),
OSPF (v2/v3), IS-IS, MPLS/LDP, BFD, and data-center protocols such as VXLAN and EVPN; ability to
configure emulated/simulated router topologies for scale and convergence testing.
o Familiarity with RFC 2544 / RFC 2889 benchmarking methodology for throughput, latency, frame loss and
back-to-back testing.
o Practical experience with AI tooling in day-to-day activities to improve productivity and delivery quality
(code generation, code review, automation, agentic AI, MCP usage, etc.).
o Experience in performance, scale, and convergence testing; ability to analyze and improve performance
and convergence at system level.
o Ability to develop and publish solution validation documents and test reports.
o Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to communicate effectively across QA and
Development teams.
o Highly motivated, self-driven, and able to collaborate cross-functionally to meet challenging goals.

jobs.description:
Bizimle hayata katılmaya var mısın?

Biz kimiz?

Türkiye Finans; Orta Doğu bölgesinin en büyük sermayeli bankalarından biri olan SNB’nin %67 hisse ortaklığı ile varlığını sürdüren Türkiye’nin en güçlü katılım bankalarından biridir.
Türkiye Finansta biz; insanı odağımıza alarak ve dijitalleşmeye önem vererek teknolojik altyapımız ile hizmet anlayışımızı her geçen gün geliştiriyoruz. Yenilikçi bir anlayışla yolumuza devam ediyor, birlikte üretip başarmanın değerini biliyor ve ortak değerlere dayanarak sürekli büyüyoruz. Birlikte büyürken amacımız; sürdürülebilir ve kârlı büyüme ile katılım bankacılığını Türkiye'de tüm birey ve şirketlerle tanıştırmaktır.

Burada seni neler bekliyor?

Çeşitliliği zenginlik olarak gören bir bankada tek ekip ruhunu çokça yaşayacak ve yaşatacaksın.
Türkiye Finans Akademi’de kişisel gelişimden liderliğe, liderlikten hobi eğitimlerine binlerce içeriğe ulaşabileceksin.
Senin için tanımlanan dijital eğitim bütçen ile sana iş hayatında destek sağlayacak eğitimleri kendin için seçebileceksin. Eğer; ‘’eğitim hayatımda bir adım daha atmak istiyorum’’ dersen de Yüksek Lisans veya Doktora desteğimiz ile de bizi yanında bulabileceksin.
Sunduğumuz esnek kariyer imkanları ile istersen kariyerini farklı alanlarda da şekillendirebileceksin.
Liderlerini içeriden yetiştirmeye önem veren bankacılık kültürümüz ve yüksek iç atama oranımız ile her zaman destekleneceksin.
Kültür, sanat ve spor kategorilerinde 10’dan fazla kulübümüzle sosyalleşme imkanı bulabileceksin.
Yarına Varız mottomuzla hayata geçirdiğimiz sürdürülebilirlik projelerimiz ile sen de doğaya katkıda bulunma fırsatı yakalayabileceksin.
Önce sağlık mottomuzdan yola çıkarak “Hayat Ağacı” markamız altındaki psikolog, doktor, diyetisyen hizmetlerimiz ve spor derslerimizle her daim bizi yanında hissedeceksin
İş – özel yaşam dengeni korumak sadece senin değil, bizim de önceliğimiz. Destekleyici politikalarımızla vaktini özel yaşamına ayırabileceksin.
Sadece seni değil sevdiklerini de çok önemsiyoruz. Tam da bu nedenle eşini ve çocuklarını da özel sağlık sigortası kapsamına alabileceksin.
Hayat ve ferdi kaza sigortamız ile beklenmedik durumlara karşı güvende olabileceksin

Özetle; bizi biz yapan; Yenilikçilik Gücümüzdür, Müşteri Odağımızdır, Çeşitlilik Zenginliğimizdir, Tek Ekibiz, Başarı Tutkumuzdur değerlerimizi Türkiye Finans yolculuğunun her anında yanında hissedeceksin.

Biz Türkiye Finans ailesinde birlikte üretip başarmanın değerini biliyor, ortak değerlere dayanarak sürekli ilerliyoruz.

Bu ekip nasıl birini arıyor?

Bilgisayar mühendisliği, yazılım mühendisliği gibi ilgili bölümlerden mezun olan,
NET Framework, C#, SQL programlama dillerine hâkim ve tercihen React JavaScript konusunda minimum 4 yıl deneyim sahibi,
Çok katmanlı mimari, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) konseptleri konularında bilgi sahibi,
İlişkisel veri tabanı sistemleri konusunda tecrübe sahibi,
Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişimi kuvvetli,
Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yetkinliğine sahip,
Scrum metodolojileriyle çalışmış veya bilgi sahibi
Tercihen bankacılık ürün ve uygulamalarında çalışmış (Kart, provizyon takip, ekstre vs)
Değişime ve öğrenmeye istekli,
Tercihen bankacılık sektöründe yazılım geliştirme alanında deneyimi olan ekip arkadaşları aramaktayız.

Bu pozisyondaki sorumlulukların ne olacak?

İhtiyaç analizi yapılmış uygulamaların geliştirilmesi, entegrasyonu, birim testlerinin yapılması,
Uygulamalarda düzeltme, iyileştirmelerin yazılım yolu ile yapılması,
Uygulamaların bankanın Yazılım Geliştirme Yaşam Döngüsü (SDLC) standartlarına uygun olarak geliştirilmesini sağlanması

Peki seni hangi adımlar bekliyor?

1- Başvuru
2- Teknik Mülakat
3- Envanter
4- SQL ve C# Testleri
5- İnsan Kaynakları Online / Yüz Yüze Mülakat

jobs.title: Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps) based in Turkey.

This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure powering large-scale web data products and distributed engineering teams. You’ll own the architecture of core control and context planes that enable services and AI-driven workflows to operate reliably and efficiently. Working across Kubernetes, Kafka, Java, Python, gRPC, and multi-cloud infrastructure, you’ll tackle complex distributed systems challenges at production scale. You’ll establish engineering standards, reliability practices, and service contracts that influence multiple product squads. The role combines hands-on architecture with technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional alignment. In a globally distributed, remote-first environment, you’ll have significant autonomy to solve challenging infrastructure problems and influence long-term platform strategy.

Accountabilities

Architect and evolve the control and context planes, advancing service and schema registries, SLO enforcement, health-aware routing, automated canary releases, and operational feedback loops.
Own the service chassis and golden path, maintaining and improving multi-language Java and Python client libraries, standardized workload specifications, Helm charts, and deployment pipelines.
Define and govern inter-service contracts, including gRPC and Protocol Buffer definitions, API gateway transcoding, versioning policies, and schema evolution standards.
Operate and improve the core platform infrastructure across Kubernetes, Terraform, HAProxy/Nginx, Confluent Kafka, real-time billing pipelines, Valkey, and database modernization initiatives.
Lead architectural strategy through Requests for Discussion (RFDs) covering workflow orchestration, gateway orchestration, multi-cluster routing, automated failover, and other critical platform initiatives.
Establish reliability engineering practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, fault isolation, and automated weighted canary deployments.
Participate in shared infrastructure on-call rotations, lead incident post-mortems, and convert operational insights into platform improvements.
Mentor engineers across multiple squads, review architectural proposals, and establish engineering practices that make reliable software development more consistent and efficient.

Requirements

10+ years of experience building scalable distributed backend systems, with a strong track record of creating internal platforms or core libraries adopted across engineering organizations.
Advanced Java expertise, including reactive frameworks such as Vert.x or Netty, combined with strong Python proficiency.
Deep experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, including schema evolution and backward compatibility in mission-critical systems.
Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes at scale, Terraform, and event-streaming platforms such as Kafka.
Experience designing automated telemetry pipelines, materialized views, feature stores, or other feedback systems that use production data to dynamically improve system behavior.
Strong reliability engineering background, including SLO/SLI definition, blast-radius analysis, fault tolerance, and rigorous service contracts.
Exceptional technical writing skills and the ability to communicate complex architectural concepts clearly while driving alignment across teams.
Strong written and interpersonal communication skills suited to a globally distributed, remote-first environment.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Architect - FDE
jobs.description:
At Quento Technologies S.A., the ICT arm of the Qualco Group, we deliver comprehensive and innovative solutions across AI, Digital Engineering, Cloud, and Cybersecurity, helping businesses accelerate digital transformation. With a presence in Greece, Luxembourg, and Belgium, and backed by the expertise of the Qualco Group, we combine deep technical knowledge with strategic partnerships to support business growth.

At Quento Technologies S.A. we empower our people to innovate and lead in delivering transformative ICT solutions to our clients worldwide.
Quento Technologies S.A. seeks a highly motivated and experienced AI Solutions Architect - FDE
, where FDE stands for Forward Deployed Engineer, you work directly with clients at the earliest stages of an opportunity: facilitating brainstorming sessions, understanding the business need, helping refine and challenge the problem statement, and translating client input into a credible technology and AI solution. Once a contract is established, you turn that solution into clear engineering requirements, align stakeholders on scope and delivery assumptions, and lead the transition from the solutions and pre-sales team to the delivery team — ensuring that what was promised can be built, shipped, and operated successfully in the client environment.

Your responsibilities will entail:
Ship production GenAI applications
— RAG systems, agentic workflows, LLM-powered products — inside client environments, from architecture through deployment, evaluation, and handover;
Own the full stack of an engagement
: data plumbing, orchestration, model integration, APIs, evaluation harnesses, observability, and the minimal UI needed to put the system in users' hands;
Drive technical pre-sales
for strategic pursuits: rapid proofs of concept, architecture workshops, and live demos that turn client ambition into scoped, winnable delivery work;
Operate confidently under regulation
: design and document systems that satisfy GDPR, and EU AI Act from day one auditability, evaluation evidence, and resilience are part of the build, not an afterthought;
Convert engagements into assets
: between deployments, distill patterns into accelerators, reference architectures, and internal tooling that make the next engagement faster;
Multiply the organization
: run one enablement workshop per engagement cycle, mentor engineers across our delivery teams, and represent Quento at meetups and conferences - building your technical brand alongside ours;
Ensuring that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements and supporting the continued implementation of the Group Anti-Bribery and Corruption Policy;
Αctively ensuring compliance with the Group's Anti-Bribery and Corruption Policy and all applicable regulations, identifying and reporting potential risks related to bribery and corruption, and promoting ethical behavior by participating in and encouraging continuous training and awareness initiatives.

What we will develop together:
Deep fluency in our AI-native delivery model and AI-SDLC framework — you will help shape it, not just follow it;
Domain depth per engagement: insurance, banking, credit management. We staff you with domain experts; you bring the build;
Advanced platform certification paths (Databricks, Azure AI) on company time and budget.Pre-sales craft: solutioning, estimation, and proposal contribution alongside senior architects.

Requirements

University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field;
Production GenAI experience — plural and provable.
You have shipped LLM applications (RAG, agents, or comparable) with real users, and you can walk us through an incident, what your evals caught and missed, and what you changed;
Evaluation and LLMOps discipline.
Eval design, regression testing of prompts and agents, observability, and cost/latency optimization are part of how you build — not a phase you skip;
Full-stack pragmatism.
You can stand up an application end to end on your own: Python, modern orchestration frameworks, APIs, and enough frontend to ship. Strong software engineering fundamentals — testing, version control, CI/CD;
Cloud production experience
, ideally on Azure; hands-on Azure Databricks or Azure AI Foundry is a strong plus;
Customer-facing composure.
You can run a whiteboard session with a client architect one day and develop a demo to a business stakeholder in another. You intelligently explain trade-offs to senior managers and stakeholders;
Comfort in regulated environments.
You have worked where GDPR is table stakes, and you treat auditability and data boundaries as design inputs. Familiarity with the EU AI Act is a plus we will deepen;
Languages.
Fluent Greek and English — this role is client-facing in the Greek market;
5+ years in software or ML engineering
, with the last 2+ focused on applied GenAI.

Your Life @ Qualco Group

On top of challenging work environment, we are offering:

💻 Cutting-edge IT equipment, mobile and data plan
🏢 Modern facilities, free coffee and beverages, indoor parking, and company bus

jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a senior .NET developer who builds that backbone.

You build the platform itself, not the screens in front of it. Your working level is domain models, APIs, messages and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team of 14 people with developers, architects, test engineers and product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on . NET 10
and C#, with PostgreSQL
for domain data, Apache Kafka
for events, Redis
for caching and ClickHouse
for high-volume telemetry. Services are containerised and run on Kubernetes, brought up locally with .NET Aspire and tested against real dependencies with Testcontainers, shipped through Azure DevOps pipelines and instrumented with OpenTelemetry
.

We are building a new back-end, designed around domain-driven design rather than carried over from what came before. The interesting questions are still open: where the domain boundaries lie, what each service owns, which events carry the truth. You get to answer them, on a fleet that is already global and still growing.

In This Role, You Will

Design and build domain services: bounded contexts, aggregates and a language the business recognises, in cloud-native .NET services that own their own data.
Own your API contracts: design APIs that others build on, version them deliberately, and treat breaking a consumer as a decision rather than an accident.
Design events, not just messages: Avro schemas in a registry, schema evolution, idempotency and replay, and a clear answer for the message that cannot be processed.
Model data for the questions it will be asked: relational design in PostgreSQL where the structure is known, JSONB where it has to stay flexible, and query patterns that still hold when the fleet doubles.
Engineer for fleet scale: hundreds of thousands of devices reporting continuously, where an unbounded consumer or a missing index is not a slow page but an outage.
Make your services observable and operable: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, health checks, and alerts worth being woken up for.
Test your own work, with unit and integration tests next to the product code against containerised dependencies rather than mocks, alongside the test engineers who build our shared framework.
Shape the design upstream and raise the bar around you: turn requirements into a workable domain model during refinement, say so when something cannot be built cleanly, and lead through review and standards people actually follow.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Several years of hands-on C# and .NET back-end development, at a level where you own a service end to end and design the APIs others build on: contracts, versioning, and the discipline of not breaking your consumers.
A working grasp of domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Hands-on with PostgreSQL, including JSONB where the model has to stay flexible, and comfortable writing and reasoning about your own SQL.
Apache Kafka as architecture, not plumbing: producers and consumers, partitions and offsets, schemas and delivery guarantees, and the distributed reality around them - asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Container-based, cloud-agnostic development: Kubernetes (AKS / EKS / OpenShift), with containers and pipelines as part of how you build, test and ship.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Designing a domain model or a service landscape from the ground up.
ClickHouse or another columnar time-series store for high-volume telemetry, and Redis at scale.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees’ development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, you will also have access to global career opportunities. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

jobs.description:
Your role

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.

You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.

As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.

You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.

You build the back-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.

Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.

To succeed, you will need

You have built back-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.

You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.

Must-have

C# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10): recent, hands-on experience building production-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
Azure: practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
REST API design and implementation: designing and consuming well-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
SQL databases: data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
Testing as part of development: unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.

Strong plus

Apache Kafka: consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
Graph databases: Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
Secure-by-default cloud development: managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
Observability: structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
Domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Microservice architecture: service boundaries, inter-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
Event-driven and message-based architecture: queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at-least-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
CI/CD with Azure DevOps: YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

Because teams are intentionally small and product-oriented, Engineers are expected to be wide in their skillset, flexible in scope, and comfortable collaborating across disciplines. Backend work is not always isolated from product, operational, or cross-team concerns — success comes from end-to-end ownership and shared accountability, not role silos.

This role is part of a broader Product Engineering culture focused on autonomy, short feedback loops, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

YOUR ROLE

As a Backend Engineer
, your mission is to design, build, and evolve backend solutions that power customer experiences and business capabilities in a reliable and sustainable way.

You do this by:

Owning solutions across their lifecycle — from design and implementation to release, monitoring, and iterative improvement.
Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and other stakeholders.
Applying strong backend craftsmanship while keeping product impact, reliability, and compliance front of mind — including through the traffic peaks that come with live sporting events.
Continuously improving systems, practices, tooling, and ways of working.
Your autonomy, scope, and influence are driven by your career ladder level, not by the job title alone.

YOUR PROFILE

What you bring

Experience as a Backend Engineer in product-oriented environments, ideally at scale and/or in regulated contexts

Experience building backend services with a statically-typed language and framework (e.g. C#/.NET, Java, Kotlin, Go), including event-driven architectures

Product-minded, collaborative, and comfortable working in small, autonomous, cross-functional teams

Experience with real-time or high-concurrency systems (e.g. live odds, in-play betting, event-driven traffic spikes), or an interest in the sports betting / iGaming domain

As well as enjoying a unique experience – centered around our values of Pleasure, Team Spirit, Performance, Boldness and Integrity – alongside 1.600 colleagues worldwide, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the international development of a fast-growing family company.

jobs.title: Application Architect
Fullstack Developer - Flutter, .NET & Connected Devices (SMARTLINK IoT Mobile)
jobs.description:
Your role

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem - commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert - so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet - flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.

You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.

You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.

You move between product discussions, Flutter development, backend services, APIs design and implementation, analytics and troubleshooting. One day is user journeys with the Product Owner and designer; the next is a Flutter feature, an ASP.NET Core endpoint, or working out from Mixpanel why a commissioning flow is being abandoned at step three.

You will be comfortable in a codebase with history and constraints, and you care as much about the problem as the solution - what frustrates the user in the field is as interesting to you as the architecture behind it.

In This Role, You Will

Build new capabilities for SMARTLINK Mobile in Flutter and Dart, and extend ASP.NET Core services and APIs behind them - owning a capability end to end rather than one side of it.
Take part in discovery and refinement: understand the persona and the journey, apply jobs-to-be-done thinking, and challenge a requirement before it is built rather than after.
Work with the Product Owner and designer from the first sketch, and say so when a flow does not hold once real devices and real field conditions are involved.
Build the commissioning and onboarding experiences for sensors, gateways and connected equipment.
Engineer for the field: intermittent connectivity, offline behaviour, slow networks, and failure states that tell the user what to do next instead of what went wrong.
Close the loop with data: adoption and usage in Mixpanel, system behaviour in New Relic, and commissioning success and failure rates treated as a first-class product metric.
Keep quality where it belongs: tests alongside the product code, code review, architecture discussions, and your share of production troubleshooting.
Leverage AI in your daily work and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

You have built and shipped a mobile or fullstack product that other people depend on - not a greenfield demo, but something with history, users and constraints. You can tell the difference between a flow that is finished and one that merely works, and you are as comfortable in a product conversation as in a stack trace. We need you to hit the ground running: come in as a solid medior and grow into owning a significant part of the mobile product, or arrive senior and set the patterns the team adopts.

Your Profile Includes

Several years of hands-on software development, at a level where you own a feature end to end: design, implementation, data, and the edge cases in between.
Strong C# and .NET, including REST APIs and backend services you have designed rather than only consumed.
Production Flutter and Dart experience - an app that real users depend on, not a demo.
Modern engineering as a habit: testing next to the product code, code review, CI/CD, and a build setup you understand.
Strong analytical and root cause skills. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Comfortable in a multidisciplinary agile team, with the confidence to say in refinement that something should not be built the way it is specified.
Fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Genuine interest in UX and product discovery - you want to understand how the user works, not just what to build.
Bluetooth Low Energy, WiFi provisioning or device onboarding development.
Connected devices, sensors and gateways, or industrial IoT more broadly.

Analytics and observability in practice: Mixpanel, New Relic, feature flags, A/B testing.
Azure, event-driven architectures and microservices.

jobs.title: Test Engineer for SmartLink IoT Platform
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a Test Engineer who owns the quality of that backbone.

You are the quality owner of the platform itself, not of the screens in front of it. Your working level is services, APIs, messages and data: does a domain service behave as its contract promises, does a telemetry value survive ingestion, aggregation and retrieval unchanged, and does any of it still hold at the scale of a global fleet. You work in an agile team of developers, architects and product owners, following and sharpening our platform testing standard
so that quality is a property of how we build, not a phase at the end. The total platform team is 14 people.

Test automation here is real engineering. Our suites are written in C# on .NET
by the same standards as the product code: xUnit, Testcontainers
to spin up Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse per run, .NET Aspire
to bring up the distributed application, and a shared helper library published as a NuGet package so every service team tests against the same building blocks. Suites run in Azure DevOps
pipelines per component and per environment, reporting into Xray
.

Your first months land in the middle of a platform generation change, with two generations running side by side while we migrate. It is a demanding start and the fastest way to learn the platform inside out, but it is not the whole job: the migration will finish, the platform will keep growing, and so will your scope.

In This Role, You Will

Test the platform where it lives: contract, schema and integration testing of domain services and APIs, message and event flows, and the persistence behind them.
Validate the data, not just the code: event streams, time-series and aggregated telemetry, from the message a device sends to the value the platform serves to its consumers.
Extend the shared test framework the other service teams build on, and keep those suites running as quality gates in CI/CD rather than by hand.
Solve testability as a design problem. Where a service cannot be validated on its own, work out what is needed (governed test data, stubs, simulators, contract tests, observability) and get it into the backlog before the feature is built, instead of testing on production machines.
Hold the platform to what it promises its consumers. The portal, the mobile apps and internal consumers depend on your services, so you own those contracts and work with those teams on the flows that cross the boundary.
Cover performance and load at fleet scale, through harnesses that drive the real processing pipeline rather than a simplified copy of it.
Prove migrations and domain transitions: dual-source comparison between old and new, backward compatibility per domain, and confidence at cutover.
Shape quality upstream and after the fact: turn requirements into test cases during refinement, challenge anything that cannot be verified, and triage defects across service boundaries.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Solid grounding in testing methodology, QA practice and defect analysis: functional, regression and risk-based testing.
You test services and APIs directly, not through a user interface. REST and messaging, schemas and contracts are your natural working level.
You write test code, and you write it properly: readable, reviewed, running in a CI/CD pipeline. We work in C# on .NET with xUnit; another statically typed language is fine, and we give you the room to switch.
Hands-on with SQL and comfortable judging whether data and aggregations are actually correct.
A working understanding of distributed, service-based architectures: asynchronous messaging, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something is not testable as specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

Architektur-Standards & Agile Führung:
Für unsere Projekte definierst du technische Standards sowie strukturierte Konzepte für komplexe IT-Landschaften. Deine Projekte steuerst du nach agilen Methoden – idealerweise untermauert durch Zertifizierungen wie Professional Scrum Developer oder Scrum Master.

Wer gut zu uns passen würde

In der Rolle als Solution IT Architect & Consultant liegt dein Schwerpunkt klar auf der strategischen Beratung, der vorausschauenden Konzeption und dem Aufsetzen moderner Architekturmuster – weniger auf der reinen operativen Umsetzung. Du begleitest Entscheidungsträger auf Augenhöhe, bewertest neue Technologien und legst das Fundament für zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen. Dazu bringst du Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse aus den folgenden Bereichen mit:
Fullstack-Engineering & Architektur-Expertise:
Du blickst auf mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Software-Architekturen zurück. Dein Tech-Stack umfasst moderne Frontend- und Backend-Technologien (z. B. TypeScript, Kotlin / Spring Boot oder .NET / C#) sowie Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD-Pipelines.
Cloud-Native & Modern Tooling:
Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastrukturen (bevorzugt AWS oder Azure) ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du entscheidest, wann Serverless- oder Hybrid-Cloud-Szenarien sinnvoll sind.
Data & AI Grundlagen:
Ein solides Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und Data Engineering rundet dein Profil ab, sodass du Kunden auch bei datengetriebenen Architekturen ganzheitlich beraten kannst.
Beratungspersönlichkeit & Unternehmergeist:
Das Schliessen der Lücke zwischen Business-Bedürfnissen und Code treibt dich an. Du denkst unternehmerisch, überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz sowie Empathie und schätzt die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Consulting und konkretem Coding.
Sprachkompetenz & Reisetätigkeit:
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Französischkenntnisse sehen wir als zusätzliche Ergänzung. Eine projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (hauptsächlich innerhalb der Schweiz, gelegentlich nach Deutschland) ist für dich kein Problem.

Dein Team

In Bern bauen wir gemeinsam das Schweizer inovex-Team auf. Dabei geht es nicht um die Mitarbeit in einem bestehenden Team, sondern um die aktive Mitgestaltung des Markteintritts und der Positionierung von inovex in der Schweiz. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Kernteam, das den Anspruch hat, inovex im Schweizer Markt nachhaltig zu etablieren – in enger Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Deutschland. Dabei verbinden wir die Erfahrung, Methoden und technologische Exzellenz eines etablierten Unternehmens mit unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort.

Unsere Konzepte implementieren wir bevorzugt mit Open Source Software im Rahmen agiler Projekte. Die meisten der von uns entwickelten Lösungen integrieren wir in bestehende IT-Systeme, weshalb wir von Beginn unserer Projekte an auf integrierte Qualitätssicherung setzen.

Bei uns verläuft kein Projekt wie das andere – je nach Kunde, Team und Technologie-Stack ist jede Lösung einzigartig. Unser Fokus ist jedoch immer derselbe: Mit innovativen Technologien und einem hohen Anspruch an die Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme wollen wir nicht nur unsere Kunden glücklich machen, sondern auch uns selbst.

Proclinical is seeking a MES System Engineer (EI&C) for a contract role based in Switzerland. Maintain, govern, and enhance MES standards, templates, best practices, and system architectures across manufacturing sites.

Develop and review GxP documentation, including specifications, risk assessments, test documentation, change controls, and SOPs.
Collaborate with Automation, IT, Validation, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to implement and maintain MES solutions aligned with business needs.

Ensure system reliability, data integrity, cybersecurity, and compliance with company standards and regulatory expectations.

Degree in Automation Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience with MES, Manufacturing IT, OT, or automation systems in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences environment.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, batch execution, and electronic records management.
Familiarity with GAMP, GMP, data integrity, and computerized system validation (CSV) practices.
IT-OT background with knowledge of manufacturing system architectures.
Experience with MES platforms such as PAS-X, Syncade, PharmaSuite, Opcenter, or similar systems.
Knowledge of OT infrastructure, industrial networking, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), and server environments.
Understanding of system integration concepts between MES, ERP, historians, and automation platforms.
Awareness of cybersecurity principles and best practices in manufacturing environments.
Proficiency in GxP documentation and change management processes.
Fluency in English and/or German.

Du analysierst komplexe Daten- und Prozesslandschaften und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.
Du übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Requirement Engineering und agierst als Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich, Produktion und IT.
Du entwickelst und implementierst Automatisierungslösungen sowie stabile Anwendungen mit Python und/oder C# und förderst die Standardisierung von Prozessen.
Du konzipierst wiederverwendbare Komponenten, interne Tools und skalierbare Verarbeitungslösungen für eine effiziente Systemlandschaft.
Du unterstützt das Team als technischer Sparring Partner, treibst Best Practices, Architektur- und CI/CD-Themen voran und sorgst durch Monitoring und Optimierung für einen stabilen Betrieb.

Worauf es uns ankommt

Langjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#.
Praxis in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungslösungen, datengetriebenen Systemen oder Workflow-Engines sowie ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der Analyse komplexer Systemlandschaften.
Erfahrung im Requirement Engineering und in der strukturierten Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in skalierbare und nachhaltige technische Lösungen.
Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Entwicklungsumgebungen sowie Verständnis für Standardisierung, Wiederverwendbarkeit und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systemlandschaften.
Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, sich rasch in komplexe Legacy-Systeme und dynamische Betriebsumfelder einzuarbeiten

Job Title:
Senior Software Engineer C# / .NET

Location:
Remote in Europe

Req ID
: 3160

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a team building backend APIs for cloud-based applications. You'll work on microservice backends that manage data and algorithms for machining, including bringing CAM functionality from desktop applications into the cloud.
Most of the work is new development. Some work involves adapting existing algorithms for cloud software, whether that means rewriting them or building the services around them. You'll take responsibility for the full software-development lifecycle: understanding the problem, shaping the solution, implementing it, validating it and maintaining its quality.

Daily Tasks:

Analyse requirements and design the architecture, implementation and structure of backend services.
Build and test C# and ASP.NET Core services for cloud-based applications.
Develop microservices that manage data and support machining algorithms and CAM functionality.
Add automated tests and take a quality-focused approach to validation.
Participate in code reviews and work closely with other software engineers, development teams and product managers.
Contribute to modern development practices, including highly automated deployments and continuous delivery.

What we're looking for

More than three years of professional software-development experience.
Experience with C# and ASP.NET Core.
Experience taking software from analysis and design through implementation, testing and validation, rather than focusing only on writing code.
An understanding of how microservices communicate, including synchronous and asynchronous approaches.
A strong attitude to software quality, including automated testing and code review.
Ability to work collaboratively in a distributed team.

Helpful experience

Cloud, web-development or microservices experience.
Experience with continuous delivery and automated deployments.
A degree, ideally in a STEM subject, is useful but not essential.

About the team

You'll join an international development team of six software engineers and a product owner, based across the UK, Germany, Romania and China. The team collaborates across European time zones.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Green Eagle Solutions is a leader in automating renewable energy operations, empowering energy producers to optimize their assets and trading strategies with innovative SaaS solutions. Our flagship platform, ARSOS, integrates advanced automation to enhance operational efficiency and trading performance, ensuring renewable energy producers can maximize revenue in dynamic energy markets. Join us in driving the energy transition and shaping the future of energy trading through cutting-edge automation.

Joining Green Eagle means growing alongside the company and becoming part of the transformative mindset that defines us. 🚀
If you are encouraged to do great things, join our team! 🤝💚

The challenge:

Green Eagle builds mission-critical energy optimisation systems. Our platform processes real-time telemetry from renewable assets and integrates with control centres and grid operators through industrial protocols. When it degrades, energy production is affected directly. That constraint shapes every architectural decision here.
We are scaling the engineering organisation, and our architecture and technical standards need to evolve with it. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will own the most ambiguous, cross-cutting technical problems in the company: scalability, reliability, architectural simplification and the quality of technical decision-making across teams. Much of the structure you will work within does not exist yet. You will help create it.
This is a senior IC role. You will not manage people. You will set technical direction, mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads, and create leverage across multiple teams. Your first months will go into understanding the products, the architecture and how the organisation actually works before proposing changes to any of it. From there, your impact will come from solving systemic problems and raising the technical ceiling of the organisation, not from owning a backlog.

Our Environment:

We value technical ownership, pragmatic architecture, reliability by design, automation over manual work, and AI-assisted engineering with measurable impact.
Our stack:
.NET services and Angular applications
AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps
GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions
PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Redis and Kafka
OpenTelemetry-aligned observability and Datadog

You do not need to be an expert in all of it from day one.

What You`ll Be Doing:

Architecture and technical strategy.
Define and guide the evolution of our product and platform architecture, including modularity, service boundaries, data flows, integrations and production readiness. Identify structural bottlenecks and reliability risks before they constrain delivery. Own build-versus-buy calls.
Cross-team initiatives.
Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from discovery to adoption. Create clarity, align stakeholders, set direction and trade-offs. Contribute directly to critical codebases and reference implementations when it creates leverage.
Engineering standards and operational quality.
Establish standards and patterns that teams actually adopt. With Platform Engineering, define operational quality at scale: observability, SLOs, alerting, incident practice, production-readiness criteria.
AI-assisted engineering
. Set how AI is used here: quality criteria, validation, security, traceability, cost. Identify where it creates real leverage and where it adds complexity and measure its impact on throughput and quality.
Mentoring and influence.
Grow senior engineers and Tech Leads through design reviews, RFCs and hands-on collaboration. Influence through credibility, not authority.
Product partnership.
Work with Product and leadership so that architectural investment, technical debt and reliability work are understood in terms of customer impact and delivery capacity.

What You need to Succeed:

Significant experience as a senior IC in complex production environments, with strong foundations in architecture, distributed systems, or platform engineering.
A track record of systems that stay scalable and reliable in production, including cloud-native systems, APIs, data flows and observability.
Experience driving ambiguous cross-team initiatives to adoption without formal authority
Architectural judgement: You can weigh delivery pressure against sustainability and explain the trade-off to engineers and executives alike.
Hands-on ability to write and review production code, and to raise the level of senior engineers through design reviews.
Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools, with a critical view of quality, security, and cost.

Why Work At Green Eagle?

💰 Compensation: €65,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on your experience and overall fit for the role.
📈 High-leverage scope: you will shape the technical foundations of a scaling organization, not maintain someone else's decisions.
🏆 Certified Great Place to Work® by our own team.
🌍 Join a purpose-driven company transforming renewable energy operations through technology.
🖥 Hybrid work model, combining remote work with our offices in Madrid or Seville.
🏡 Flexible working hours.
💰 Flexible compensation package (childcare, transportation, and meals).
🏥 Private health insurance.
🌱 Annual learning and sports activity allowance.
👌 Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of brands and services.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps) based in Saudi Arabia.

This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure powering large-scale web data products and distributed engineering teams. You’ll own the architecture of core control and context planes that enable services and AI-driven workflows to operate reliably and efficiently. Working across Kubernetes, Kafka, Java, Python, gRPC, and multi-cloud infrastructure, you’ll tackle complex distributed systems challenges at production scale. You’ll establish engineering standards, reliability practices, and service contracts that influence multiple product squads. The role combines hands-on architecture with technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional alignment. In a globally distributed, remote-first environment, you’ll have significant autonomy to solve challenging infrastructure problems and influence long-term platform strategy.

Accountabilities

Architect and evolve the control and context planes, advancing service and schema registries, SLO enforcement, health-aware routing, automated canary releases, and operational feedback loops.
Own the service chassis and golden path, maintaining and improving multi-language Java and Python client libraries, standardized workload specifications, Helm charts, and deployment pipelines.
Define and govern inter-service contracts, including gRPC and Protocol Buffer definitions, API gateway transcoding, versioning policies, and schema evolution standards.
Operate and improve the core platform infrastructure across Kubernetes, Terraform, HAProxy/Nginx, Confluent Kafka, real-time billing pipelines, Valkey, and database modernization initiatives.
Lead architectural strategy through Requests for Discussion (RFDs) covering workflow orchestration, gateway orchestration, multi-cluster routing, automated failover, and other critical platform initiatives.
Establish reliability engineering practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, fault isolation, and automated weighted canary deployments.
Participate in shared infrastructure on-call rotations, lead incident post-mortems, and convert operational insights into platform improvements.
Mentor engineers across multiple squads, review architectural proposals, and establish engineering practices that make reliable software development more consistent and efficient.

Requirements

10+ years of experience building scalable distributed backend systems, with a strong track record of creating internal platforms or core libraries adopted across engineering organizations.
Advanced Java expertise, including reactive frameworks such as Vert.x or Netty, combined with strong Python proficiency.

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer with a strong interest in AI to help shape the future of a proven SaaS platform in the real estate sector. The product is well established, but AI is opening up new possibilities for automation and how users interact with the platform.

This is a new area for the company, so you will have plenty of room to experiment. We are looking for someone who is willing to push boundaries, test ideas and ask: why are we still doing this manually if AI can do it?

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience, a solid understanding of backend development and databases, and a genuine interest in AI. You don't need years of AI experience. What matters is that you understand how software works and are excited to explore how agents can be built and integrated into a real product.

You will work closely with the engineering team to experiment, build prototypes and turn successful ideas into reliable features. Most importantly, you are curious, pragmatic and not afraid to try something new.
