Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit.
Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive.
Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse.

Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher.
Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung.

DEIN PROFIL

Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz.
Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit.
Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET.
LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle.
Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

About the role:

Join our ERP Engineering team iand help shape the technology behind one of Europe's largest and most advanced e-commerce fulfilment operations. You'll develop and enhance Microsoft Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management solutions that keep our logistics hub running efficiently, working alongside Product Teams, Functional Consultants and warehouse stakeholders to optimise warehouse processes, inventory management and fulfilment capabilities through innovative engineering solutions.

About the tech stack:

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management (WMS), X++, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Lifecycle Services (LCS), SQL Server, T-SQL, Electronic Reporting (ER), SSRS Reporting, Data Management Framework (DMF), OData Services, REST APIs, Business Events, Dual-write, Power Platform (Power Apps & Power Automate), Git, CI/CD Pipelines.

About your tasks:

Design and build Microsoft Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management (WMS) solutions that support high-volume warehouse operations across inbound logistics, inventory management and outbound fulfilment.
Develop custom X++ solutions, integrations, Data Entities, APIs, workflows and business events, connecting Dynamics 365 with warehouse technologies and surrounding enterprise systems.
Enhance warehouse execution processes, including receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping and inventory movements to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
Drive engineering excellence by performing code reviews, mentoring colleagues, optimising application performance and contributing to CI/CD, release management and Microsoft development best practices.
Collaborate closely with Warehouse Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Product Teams, QA Engineers and warehouse stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle, from solution design through production deployment.

Qualifications

You have extensive experience developing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions with strong expertise in Warehouse Management (WMS) and X++ development.
You understand warehouse operations, fulfilment and inventory management processes, and enjoy translating operational challenges into scalable technical solutions.
You have experience building enterprise integrations using REST APIs, OData, Data Management Framework (DMF), Business Events or Dual-write and are passionate about developing clean, maintainable code.
You enjoy working closely with technical and business colleagues in an international environment and are excited to contribute to the continuous evolution of our warehouse technology landscape in Sevenum.

Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit.
Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive.
Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse.
LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher.
Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung.

DEIN PROFIL

Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahre mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz.
Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit.
Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET.
LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle.
Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus.
Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. new_jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer (m/w/d) - Jobbird.com
new_jobs.description:
Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen sind wir in 19 Ländern tätig und beschäftigen über 9.000 engagierte Mitarbeitende. Du wirst in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld arbeiten, das voller Möglichkeiten steckt. Mit Deinem Einsatz und Deiner Leidenschaft hast Du die Gelegenheit, einen nachhaltigen Unterschied zu machen.

CGM Leverages AI:
Wir suchen Menschen, die die Kraft von KI im E-Health-Umfeld spüren, den Wandel mitgestalten wollen und mit neugieriger Leidenschaft erkennen, wie Technologie Gesundheit smarter, einfacher und besser machen kann.

Gemeinsam gestalten wir das Gesundheitssystem der Zukunft. Werde Teil unserer Mission und mache den Unterschied – für eine Welt, in der Wissen Leben rettet!

Dein Beitrag:

Du konzipierst und verantwortest Ende-zu-Ende-Teststrategien über alle Ebenen hinweg – Unit-, Integrations-, System-, UI-, Stress- und Performance-Tests – für unsere medizinischen Softwareprodukte.
Du baust und entwickelst Test-Harnesses und CI-Pipelines weiter, die Regressionen früh erkennen, stabil und skalierbar laufen und unseren C++-Desktop-, .NET- und modernen Web-Stacks schnelles, verlässliches Feedback liefern.
Du planst, implementierst und analysierst Last- und Performance-Tests, identifizierst Engpässe und Stabilitätsrisiken und treibst gemeinsam mit den Entwicklerteams messbare Qualitätsverbesserungen voran.
Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, Architektur und Produktmanagement zusammen, agierst als Qualitäts-Gewissen des Teams und verankerst testgetriebene "Shift-Left"-Engineering-Praktiken.
Du nutzt AI-Agents und Tools wie Claude Code gezielt, um Tests zu generieren, zu pflegen und zu triagieren, und baust wiederverwendbare Automatisierungs-Skills und Workflows für die gesamte QA-Community auf.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung auf Senior-Level mit tiefem Verständnis für mehrschichtige Testframeworks sowie erprobte Praxis in Last- und Performance-Tests, idealerweise in regulierten oder sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen.

We empower our people with a culture of excellence, and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone's contribution is welcomed.

We are looking for a Senior Azure Data Architect to join us as part of our team.

About The Role

As an Enterprise Azure Data Architect, you will support a broad set of architectural needs across multiple workstreams. In this role, you will design and own the data layer behind GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI applications, ensuring enterprise data and knowledge are effectively ingested, prepared, stored, governed, and made available for AI consumption and retrieval.

Our stack

Azure Data Platform, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Azure SQL MI / SQL Server / T-SQL, Azure Data Lake / Lakehouse architecture, Azure Functions.

Own and design the data architecture, data modeling, ingestion, and platform modernization for enterprise Azure environments
Design the data layer supporting GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI applications, including how enterprise data and knowledge are ingested, prepared, stored, governed, and made available for retrieval and AI consumption
Design and implement scalable, metadata/configuration-driven data ingestion and data platform solutions
Work with both structured and genuinely unstructured data across the enterprise platform
Modernize existing data platforms and ensure implementation-ready architecture

Strong background in enterprise Azure Data Architecture with proven depth in Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Synapse Analytics
Real production project experience designing or contributing to the data/knowledge layer supporting GenAI, RAG, or Agentic AI applications
Demonstrated personal ownership of the data/knowledge architecture behind a production RAG/Agentic application (including data preparation for retrieval and vector-search/storage technology selection)
Hands-on experience with Azure Data Platform technologies, including Azure Synapse Analytics (with specific experience designing/working with its capabilities), Azure Databricks, Azure SQL MI / SQL Server / T-SQL, Azure Data Lake / Lakehouse architecture, and Azure Functions
Experience in data modeling, ingestion pipelines, and modernizing existing data platforms
Hands-on experience handling structured and genuinely unstructured data
Proven ability to design scalable, metadata/configuration-driven ingestion architectures

Reveal great tech solutions

new_jobs.description:
This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Staff

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Founded in 1980, Ashoka pioneered the field of social entrepreneurship. We are now the largest association of leading social entrepreneurs in the world, a network of 4000+ Ashoka Fellows in 99 countries at work creating systemic change on the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time. We find, support and collaborate with our Fellows to help scale their solutions across nations and continents and work with a wide range of partners to create an "Everyone a Changemaker" world, one in which we all can find and develop our power to create meaningful change for the good of all.

For more information, please visit www.ashoka.org

Job Description

Ashoka is looking for senior-level professionals in Web Design, Development and Tech Support who can provide our Fellows with professional consults and project based support. We are creating an elite team of 10-15 members from different world regions (to reflect cultural contexts and language) in this field and in seven others of similarly high-value skillsets. We are calling these members Ashoka Professional Support Partners (PSPs) rather than "volunteers" to reflect the expertise and commitment to impact they will bring to our global community.

As an Ashoka Support Partner your expertise will be promoted to Fellows over the course of two to three months. If there is a need that meets your interests and availability, an introduction will be made so that you can learn more details about the support partnership and ways that you can contribute. Until that time your name and contact details will be held confidentially to protect your privacy.

As a Member Of The Web Design, Development And Tech Solutions Team You Will Be Working At The Intersection Of Digital Craft, Social-enterprise Literacy, And Capacity-building. Our Ashoka Fellows Are Leading Social Entrepreneurs Running Organizations That Often Need Stronger Digital Foundations To Scale Their Impact. A Senior Professional On This Team Would Help To Secure

Website security and vulnerability management
Backup and disaster recovery planning
Cloud platform management
AI-ready content architecture (good to have!)

Some of the CRM and Constituent systems fellows may need would be:

Salesforce
Microsoft Dynamics
HubSpot
Donor management systems
Constituent relationship managemen

Beyond the website itself, fellows would probably need support in the following technology areas:

Marketing Technology Stack ( Email marketing, campaigns, marketing automation etc)
Global reach (internationalization, localization, translation management, right to left language support)
Performance Engineering (Core Web Vitals, CDN strategies etc)
Mobile performance (this could actually be very crucial for fellows in emerging markets where most of their marketing will happen on Mobile platforms)
Platform Governance and Strategy (editorial permissions architecture, platform sustainability etc)

To summarize what is added above, it could help to have the following:

Experience with modern web architecture, security, performance optimization, AI-ready content systems, structured data, and advanced SEO/discoverability practices.
Demonstrated expertise in website security, accessibility, multilingual implementations, cloud hosting environments, and scalable content management architectures.
Build or rebuild Fellow and Fellow-led organizations' websites — from strategy and information architecture through design, development, and launch — so Fellows can credibly tell their story, recruit supporters, and raise funds online.
Design brand-aligned digital experiences — visual identity, UI/UX, landing pages, donation/fundraising flows, and campaign microsites that reflect each Fellow's mission and audience.
Modernize and maintain existing sites — auditing, migrating, and upgrading legacy platforms applying rigor to Fellows' sites.
Integrate essential nonprofit tooling — connecting sites to CRM/donor systems, email platforms, payment/donation processors, analytics, and multilingual/localization support for Fellows working across regions.
Coach and build Fellow capacity — transferring skills to Fellows and their teams so they can update content, run campaigns, and sustain their digital presence independently rather than depending on outside help indefinitely.

Please let us know today if you'd like to join this small but mighty team! You will be deeply appreciated and never taken for granted!

Volunteer Logistics

Estimated hours required per week: 5-10

The estimated duration of the project is: 1-3 months

This position is Virtual (Remote)

Language Requirements

English, other Languages a big plus

Desired Skills And Experience

8+ years of progressively responsible web design, development and tech solutions experience, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead role (leading builds, mentoring, or owning architecture decisions).
A demonstrated portfolio of live websites spanning design through deployment, ideally including nonprofit, multilingual, or multi-site/multi-region projects.
Proven experience working remotely in distributed, cross-cultural teams.
Strong command of user-centered design, information architecture, and visual/brand design principles.
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) and prototyping.
Understanding of accessibility, responsive/mobile-first design, and performance. Development skills Front-end: HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, and a framework such as React.
Back-end and CMS fluency — especially Drupal and/or WordPress, with experience in theming, custom modules, and migrations.
Experience integrating third-party systems (Salesforce/CRM, donation platforms, email tools) and working with APIs.
Familiarity with cloud hosting and DevOps basics and basic SEO/analytics setup.
Literacy in social entrepreneurship and systems-change work, so digital solutions serve mission and scale rather than just looking polished.
Experience with budget-conscious, resource-light environments typical of early-stage Fellow organizations.

A coaching, capacity-strengthening mindset — willingness to teach and document, not just deliver.

CSQ427R155

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The Impact You Will Have

Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What We Look For

6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
Documentation and white-boarding skills.
Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
Travel to customers 20% of the time
Databricks Certification

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. new_jobs.title: Experienced Solution Architect - Cloud, Solna
new_jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of cloud-based API solutions? Join PostNord in Stockholm as an experienced Solution Architect and help build digital services that make a real difference.

At PostNord, technology and social responsibility come together to create digital solutions used by millions of people every day. As an experienced Solution Architect, you will play a key role in shaping our digital future. We offer a collaborative, forward-looking environment where innovation is encouraged, ideas are valued, and your work has a meaningful impact.

What We Offer You

A strategic role with the opportunity to influence key architectural decisions and the design of future-ready system support.
Work with clear social relevance, contributing to logistics solutions that support people, businesses, and society.
A value-driven workplace that prioritizes wellbeing, flexibility, and sustainable work-life balance.
Strong opportunities for professional development, including sponsorship for cloud certifications.
A hybrid way of working, with access to a newly renovated office in Solna.

What You Will Do With Us

You will join Sender Solutions within Customer Solutions at PostNord Group IT. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the Booking API team and other teams across Sender Solutions to define architecture that meets today’s business needs while preparing for tomorrow’s opportunities. Our solutions must meet high expectations for reliability, scalability, and efficiency, supporting both our customers and our long-term technology strategy.

Your role in brief

Shape the design and architecture of digital shipping solutions in close collaboration with the tech lead, product owner, and colleagues in the team.
Spend part of your time contributing hands-on as a system developer in the Booking API team, maintaining deep solution knowledge and staying closely connected to the team’s day-to-day work.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of large-scale solutions and integrations with complex dependencies.
Represent Sender Solutions in cross-area architecture forums, working closely with tech leads across the area.
Support product owners and teams in dialogue with major customers.
Drive innovation and continuous improvement to deliver solutions that meet evolving customer needs.

,

You Will Join a Skilled Team Of Around Ten Developers Working Across Both Back-end And Front-end Development. You Will Work Closely With The Team’s Product Owner, And Your Immediate Manager Will Be Annika Dahlström. The Team Uses Technologies Such As

AWS Microservices / Serverless.
NodeJS / JavaScript / TypeScript / Java
DynamoDB, Postgres, SQS, IAM, OAuth2, Fargate, S3, Elasticsearch, to name a few.
Swagger, Grafana, GitHub, XML/JSON, CI/CD

We are an engaged and ambitious team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning. Most of the team works from our office in Solna, with additional developers based in the Philippines. We apply a hybrid working model, with at least 60% of working time spent at the office. For this role, we would welcome a Solution Architect who can be on site more frequently to support close collaboration. We also offer flexible working hours.

More About You

You are an experienced architect with solid expertise in cloud technologies, system development, and API development. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and thrive in a role where you guide, inspire, and support your team. You have an academic degree in IT, or equivalent practical experience, and communicate fluently in both Swedish and English. Experience from the logistics industry is an advantage, as is an understanding of how emerging technologies, including AI, can be applied to create business value.

Above all, you are collaborative, strategic, and customer-focused. You communicate clearly and adapt your message to different audiences and levels of technical understanding.

About Us

We move the Nordics forward. PostNord offers reliable and fast services in parcel, mail and integrated logistics across the Nordics, with a clear target of reaching net-zero emissions by 2040. By connecting people, places, and opportunities, we help our customers grow and provide convenient deliveries for consumers. With our unique Nordic network and climate leadership, we shape the future of e commerce and logistics. In 2025, the Group had around 27,000 employees and sales of SEK 36,2 billion. The Parent Company is a Swedish public limited company with Group headquarters in Solna, Sweden. We are PostNord - a fantastic company to work and grow with. Read more at group.postnord.com

Apply

Welcome to submit your application. The selection is ongoing, so please apply as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, certain positions may require a background check. If you progress to a stage where a background check is necessary, you will be informed in advance.

If you have any questions or concerns, please email emina.delkic@postnord.com.

We look forward to hearing from you!

new_jobs.description:
Creditsafe are expanding their Consumer Bureau team, an exciting new project aiming to have us enter the Consumer Credit Bureau space in the United Kingdom and eventually become a fully-fledged Consumer Reporting Agency. We’re looking for a Quality Engineer experienced in testing cloud-native software systems.

WHO WE ARE

Privately owned and independently minded, at Creditsafe, we are guided by values of customer-focus, trust, respect, and a willingness to try new things. For over 20 years, these values have shaped a culture of growth, innovation, and support, where our team members build successful, long-term careers.
With a diverse team spread across 25 offices in 14 countries, we value collaboration, learning, and problem-solving together. We have been featured twice in The Sunday Times' '100 Best Companies to Work For' and continue to prioritize well-being, career growth, and inclusion.
Our continued success has made us the most used business data provider in the world and one of the industry’s strongest growing business intelligence providers. Today Creditsafe has 23 offices across 3 continents serving 110,000 customers from SMEs to enterprise businesses.

THE TEAM

This opportunity is to join an Agile team of Software, Data and Quality engineers who are responsible for two - one productionized and one upcoming – big data projects. These projects process hundreds of GB a day in massive ELTL ingest, person-centric matching, and sub-second-serving batch and near-real-time processes.
The wider Quality Engineering community within Creditsafe work together in driving a culture of quality into the teams acting as knowledge experts on quality. We test throughout the lifecycle and believe that the whole team is responsible for the quality of our deliverables. We implement intelligent automation and are proponents of thinking critically about the features developed by our teams.

YOUR ROLE

You will validate data correctness across every layer of the stack: ingest, transformation, warehouse, and API. You will write SQL to interrogate millions of rows, build Python test suites that run against cloud infrastructure, and work directly with engineers and analyst to trace data issues from source to serving.
You will collaborate closely with our sister Data Analytics, and product teams, from the beginning stages of development, offering input on system design and testing strategies and ensuring our feature output matches their expectations and demands.
This is a hybrid position, requiring attendance in the office for 50% of the working week, in line with our hybrid work policy.

YOUR TOOL STACK

SQL. You'll write queries daily.
Python. PyTest, automation frameworks, data validation scripts
Pandas (or Spark/Polars). For dataset analysis and comparison.
AWS. Our stack includes Redshift, S3, S3Tables (Iceberg), DynamoDB, Aurora (Postgres), Step Functions, Airflow, Lambda, ECS, Glue, among others. You don't need to know all of them, but experience with any AWS data services (or equivalent in Azure or GCP) is a strong start.
API testing tools. Postman, Bruno, or similar.
Locust (or k6/Gatling/JMeter). For load and performance testing against data APIs and pipelines.
Git.
Azure DevOps. Boards, pipelines, repos, test plans.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Data Pipeline Testing: Build and maintain automated tests for data pipelines from ingest all the way until serving layer. Validate record counts, schema integrity, transformation logic, and cross-source consistency.
Data Validation: Verify correctness, completeness, and accuracy across Redshift, Aurora, S3, and DynamoDB. Trace individual records through the full pipeline when something doesn't add up.
API Testing: Test search and lookup APIs against expected data outcomes, not just status codes, but whether the right records come back with the right values.
Performance Testing: Design and run load tests against APIs and data pipelines using Locust or similar tools. Identify bottlenecks, validate SLAs, and ensure the system handles production-scale volumes.
Early Involvement: Join refinement sessions, challenge acceptance criteria and flag gaps before code is written.
Automation: Build test suites in PyTest that run in CI/CD. Integration tests against real AWS infrastructure, not just mocks.
Troubleshooting: When a pipeline produces wrong results, you find where and why. Clear reports, reproducible queries, root cause analysis.

We will support your learning and provide resources to help you grow in this role.
WHAT YOU BRING
Experience: Proven experience testing data systems, pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT, not just web applications.
SQL: Good SQL skills. You can write joins, procs, and aggregations to validate data across tables.
Python: Good Python for test automation, scripting, and data analysis.
Cloud: Familiarity with AWS data services (Redshift, S3, DynamoDB, Aurora) or an equivalent cloud stack.
Analytical Mindset: You look at a dataset and spot what's wrong, not just confirm what's right.
Automation: Experience integrating test suites with CI/CD pipelines.
Performance: Experience with performance and load testing tools (Locust, k6, Gatling, or similar) is desired.
Communication: Ability to explain data issues clearly to engineers and product owners.
Leadership: Experience mentoring junior engineers is a plus.

WHY CREDITSAFE
IC ladder with teeth. Staff and Principal are a destination, not a waypoint - with scope, comp and influence that genuinely match the title.
Written design culture. Anything non-trivial gets an RFC. Decisions are recorded. We disagree in documents, not in meetings.
Real operability. We run what we build. No hand-offs to a separate ops team.
Pragmatic agile. Teams own their own process. We optimise for shipping, not ceremony.
Customer-first. Our focus is on making work that adds value to our clients first. Stability, freshness, durability, trust – non-negotiable.
Leadership you’ll want to work with. Engineering leadership is technical, present, and will back your calls.

Benefits
Competitive Salary.
Company Laptop
Bonus Scheme.
25 Days Annual Leave (plus bank holidays).
Hybrid working model.
Healthcare & Company Pension.

We’re looking for an experienced AI Solution Architect to join Vincit and help our customers turn AI from hype into real business value.

In this role, you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with a strong business mindset, working across software development, AI architecture, and customer collaboration. You’ll help customers identify where AI creates real value and design solutions that are both technically solid and commercially meaningful.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the code while also helping customers and teams make the right technical and architectural decisions. You’ll work closely with clients, designers, software engineers, and data experts to shape AI solutions that scale beyond proof-of-concepts and deliver measurable impact.

You know you’ve succeeded when customers clearly understand the value of AI, solutions make it into production, and your work creates meaningful outcomes for both the business and its users.

What is the job like, really?

Our customer base and projects are broad and diverse, ranging from startups to globally operating enterprises, and from early-stage AI experiments to large-scale production solutions. You'll work in both advisory-focused engagements and hands-on delivery projects where Vincit takes full responsibility for the solution.

Here’s a Snapshot Of Your Key Responsibilities

☘️ Building AI solutions –
designing and implementing production-grade AI applications, integrations, and agentic workflows together with development teams

☘️ Acting as a technical lead –
ensuring technical quality, clarity, and scalability throughout the delivery lifecycle

☘️ Designing scalable architectures –
creating technical blueprints and solution architectures for modern AI and cloud-native applications

☘️ Consulting customers on AI opportunities
– helping clients identify where AI can create genuine business value

☘️ Leading discovery and proof-of-concepts
– facilitating workshops, technical discovery sessions, and validating new ideas quickly

☘️ Supporting sales and business development
– shaping proposals and acting as a trusted technical expert in customer discussions

☘️ Translating complexity into business value
– communicating AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences

☘️ Sharing knowledge and mentoring others
– supporting colleagues across engineering, design, and data disciplines

What are we looking for? 🔍

You’ll do well in this role if you enjoy solving real business problems with technology. You’re comfortable moving between hands-on development, architectural thinking, and customer discussions, and you know how to translate technical possibilities into practical outcomes.

You’re also curious by nature and excited to keep learning – whether that means experimenting with the latest AI capabilities, exploring new cloud services, or finding better ways to build scalable AI solutions.

Your background

🎯 Strong software engineering background, ideally in web development, cloud-native applications, or distributed systems

🎯 Strong experience designing and building AI-powered applications or solutions

🎯 Experience with modern agentic AI patterns, workflows, and development practices

🎯 Experience working with customer-facing projects or consultancy environments

🎯 Strong understanding of cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and their AI capabilities

🎯 Hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, or similar technologies

🎯 Ability to combine technical expertise with business understanding

🎯 Strong communication skills across both technical and business audiences

🎯 Full professional proficiency in Finnish

It’s a Strong Plus If You Have

🎯 Experience bringing AI or agentic AI solutions from proof-of-concept into production

🎯 Experience with Azure AI services, Azure AI Foundry, or other modern AI platforms

🎯 Certifications in Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS, or Google Cloud technologies

What's in it for you?

As a 500-person company, we combine the support and career opportunities of a larger organization with the agility and low hierarchy of a smaller one. This gives you both the structure to succeed and the freedom to shape how things are done – together with a supportive community around you.

Here are a few more reasons why Vincit is worth considering:

🌟 Variety and impact in projects –
from smaller implementations to large business transformations, often involving real business change, not just system implementations.

🌟 AI at the core –
work with modern AI tools in your daily work, deepen your expertise, and contribute to building AI-driven solutions. In 2026, we became the first company in Finland to receive the ISO/IEC 42001 certification for our AI management system.

🌟 Strong partner ecosystem –
as a Microsoft Solutions Partner and SAP Gold Partner, we work closely with leading technology providers, giving you access to high-quality projects and deep expertise.

🌟 Trusted and responsible way of working –
our EcoVadis assessment and ISO certifications ensure high-quality, secure, and responsible delivery for our customers.

And what else do you get as a Vincitizen?

🌟 Flexibility & work-life balance –
shape your work around your life, whether it’s family, hobbies, or something else important to you, while also making use of our top-notch office spaces in an award-winning workplace

🌟 Solid pay –
your monthly base salary reflects your experience and expertise. In addition, you’ll benefit from Vincit’s bonus model, personnel fund, and transparent salary weeks

🌟 Comprehensive benefits –
including lunch benefit, healthcare and dental services, insurance, childcare services, high-quality equipment, and more

🌟 Growth & career opportunities –
develop your skills through Univincity and shape your path toward new roles, specializations, or directions. Read inspiring examples of career paths in our career stories.

🌟 Active communities –
a transparent and humane organization where people connect, collaborate, and have fun together. It’s where our belief, “extraordinary things are created together”, comes to life – and one of the reasons we’re an award-winning workplace.

🌟 Commitment to inclusion –
we believe in a more inclusive digital world and strive to create a safe, welcoming welcoming workplace for everyone

👉 Explore real-life examples of our human-centric culture in our
People & Culture blog
and learn more about how we work in our
Code of Conduct

Curious but still on the fence?

If you’d like to learn more about the role or have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at careers@vincit.com.

To get to know us as an employer, we recommend checking our career site, blog, Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn. You might also like our post about Vincit’s candidate-friendly recruitment process.

P.S. Please note that if you live abroad and want to work with us, we need you to have the necessary permits for working in Finland.

We believe that extraordinary things are created together. That’s why we’re on a mission to create better Mondays – for our people, our clients, and our planet. Join us and become part of a community of top professionals across different areas of IT, united by curiosity, empathy, and a drive to build things that truly matter.

new_jobs.title: Solution Area Architect (Helsinki)
new_jobs.description:
Etsimme Solution Area Architectia!

Solution Area Architectina
vastaat Elisan toimittamisen, talouden ja tukiprosessien sovellusalueiden arkkitehtuurista ja kehittämisestä. Työskentelet liiketoiminnan, IT:n ja toimittajien rajapinnassa varmistaen, että järjestelmät, integraatiot ja toimintamallit tukevat liiketoiminnan tavoitteita sekä tulevaisuuden tarpeita.

Liityt 10 hengen asiantuntijatiimiin, joka vastaa näiden sovellusalueiden kehityksestä. Roolissasi ohjaat kehityskokonaisuuksia, osallistut kehityshankkeisiin ja edistät uusien ratkaisujen käyttöönottoa yhteistyössä eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Samalla tuot uusia näkökulmia ja teknologiamahdollisuuksia liiketoiminnan kehittämiseen.

✅ Odotamme Sinulta

Taustaa ratkaisu- tai integraatioarkkitehdin tehtävistä sekä kykyä IT-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen.
Näyttöjä ERP-ratkaisujen uudistamis-, käyttöönotto- tai transformaatiohankkeista.
Ymmärrystä talous- ja toimitusketjun hallinnan prosesseista sekä niiden kehittämisestä.
Osaamista ERP-järjestelmistä, erityisesti SAP S/4HANA- tai Microsoft Dynamics 365 -ympäristöistä ja niiden keskeisistä integraatioista.
Kyky toimia tehokkaasti liiketoiminnan, IT:n, toimittajien ja muiden sidosryhmien välisenä yhteistyön mahdollistajana.
IT-järjestelmien ylläpidon prosessit, mukaan lukien järjestelmien budjetointi, elinkaaren hallinta ja tietoturva.
Ymmärrät tekoälyn hyödyntämismahdollisuudet järjestelmien, prosessien ja operatiivisen toiminnan kehittämisessä.
Alempaa korkeakoulututkintoa tietotekniikan alalta tai vastaavaa osaamista hankittuna työkokemuksen kautta.
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.

💡 Lisäksi Arvostamme, Jos Sinulla On Kokemusta

Sovellusarkkitehtuurien kehittämisestä mikropalveluarkkitehtuureilla.
API-rajapinnoista ja niiden hallinnasta. Erityisesti arvostamme TM Forum Open API -rajapintojen ja TM Forum -tietomallien tuntemusta.
Pilvipohjaisista integraatio- ja kehitysalustoista, kuten Azure Integration Services-, SAP BTP- tai vastaavista ratkaisuista.
Tietoliikennealan liiketoimintaprosesseista ja järjestelmäympäristöistä.

Emme odota, että täytät kaikki vaatimukset täydellisesti. Jos tunnistat itsesi roolin keskeisistä osaamisista ja sinulla on motivaatio kasvaa tehtävässä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

💙
Tervetuloa joukkoomme!

Tässä tehtävässä saat mukavat ja osaavat työkaverit, kiinnostavat ja vaihtelevat työtehtävät, ja pääset kehittämään sovelluksia ja työkaluja, joilla on aidosti vaikutusta sekä meidän elisalaisten että asiakkaidemme sujuvaan arkeen. Henkilökohtaista kehittymistäsi tuetaan ja pääset myös tiimin mukana kehittämään toimintamallejamme jatkuvan parantamisen hengessä.

Toimipisteesi voi sijaita Helsingissä Pasilassa tai vaihtoehtoisesti jossain muussa Elisan toimipisteessä Suomessa
. Me Elisalla uskomme kasvokkaisen vuorovaikutuksen merkitykseen kulttuurimme ylläpitämisessä ja kehittämisessä sekä yhteenkuuluvuuden ja yhteisöllisyyden vahvistamisessa. Meillä on käytössä hybridityön malli, jossa odotamme työskentelyä toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.

Kiinnostuitko?
Älä turhaan aikaile hakemuksesi kanssa sillä haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana! Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Jukka-Pekka Venäläinen. Tiedustelut ja soittopyynnöt sähköpostilla (jukka-pekka.venalainen@elisa.fi).

The chosen candidate will undergo drug test and a security clearance, which in turn requires having stayed in Finland for multiple years.

new_jobs.title: AI Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Do you want to build advanced AI agents that solve real business problems, not just prototypes? Are you excited by combining software engineering and AI into production-ready solutions?

As we grow our Data & AI practice in Finland, we are looking for AI Engineers to strengthen our technical capabilities and help deliver innovative solutions for our clients. Building on our successful project delivery, we are expanding our team and welcome applications from both early-career and experienced professionals.

You will join a global Data, Analytics & AI community helping leading organizations turn data into business value through data strategy, engineering, advanced analytics, AI, and intelligent automation.

About The Role

You thrive at the intersection of software engineering, business, and AI. You enjoy building modern applications and turning emerging technologies into production-ready solutions that create business value. You are equally comfortable understanding client needs and translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

In This Role, You Will, For Example

Build, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications, AI agents, and cloud-native solutions
Design scalable architectures and integrate applications across frontend, backend, cloud, and enterprise environments
Develop intelligent software solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, MCP, and agentic AI capabilities
Work directly with clients to understand business challenges and translate requirements into scalable technical solutions
Identify and help shape opportunities where AI can create measurable business value for clients
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver end-to-end solutions from concept to production
Present technical solutions and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders

The exact focus and responsibilities of the role will be tailored to your experience level and interests.

We Are Looking For

Background in software engineering through professional experience, studies, and/or personal projects, with experience or a strong interest in building software solutions
Experience in working across frontend, backend, and cloud environments
Experience in designing, integrating, and consuming APIs
Solid understanding of cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS) and infrastructure-as-code concepts
Exposure to Generative AI, LLM-based applications, or related AI technologies
Curiosity and a desire to continuously learn and experiment
Fluent communication skills in English (written and spoken), preferably also in Finnish and/or Swedish

Nice-to-have Qualifications Include

Hands-on experience with LLMs, reasoning models, AI agents, RAG, and agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph
Experience in building reliable AI agent workflows, including tool use, function calling, validation, and human-in-the-loop processes
Understanding of AI evaluation, observability, monitoring, and tracing
Knowledge of AI governance, security, guardrails, and responsible AI practices
Experience working with clients and stakeholders, ideally in a consulting environment

What We Offer You

Steep learning curve & interesting projects: We combine deep technology expertise with strong functional and industry knowledge. You’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GenAI technologies and modern cloud platforms, helping clients solve complex business challenges. From designing AI agents to integrating LLM-powered capabilities into enterprise solutions, you will turn emerging technologies into measurable business value.
Personal & professional growth: We invest in our people. We support the development of your personal competencies and long-term career progression through regular development discussions, formal training, and hands-on project work.
Flexible work culture: We have a people-oriented culture where your work-life balance is supported with flexible working hours and hybrid working possibilities. Our office located in the center of Helsinki provides a modern and comfortable working space when you work on-site.
Competitive compensation & benefits: We offer a competitive compensation package, including a performance-based bonus, coupled with a wide range of benefits.
Great team spirit: We focus on teaming also outside of project work through a variety of after-work activities and events together with your colleagues. We look forward to welcoming you to our collaborative and supportive team.

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer. For us, diversity and inclusion are an important part of our employment proposition. We want everyone to fulfill their potential and be themselves, regardless of background. To learn more about us and our culture, you can check out our video and visit www.bearingpoint.com. You can also follow our latest news and daily life on Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and blog.   

If this sounds like the next step in your career, join us!

We look forward to receiving your application by October 25th
. Please note that we will review applications and start interviews before the deadline. This is a permanent full-time position based in Helsinki.

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. The company operates in three business units: Consulting, Products, and Capital. Consulting covers the advisory business with a clear focus on selected business areas. Products provides IP-driven digital assets and managed services for business-critical processes. Capital delivers M&A and transaction services. BearingPoint’s clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. The firm has a global consulting network with more than 13,000 people and supports clients in over 70 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success. In Finland, we are focusing on Consulting and are located in the heart of Helsinki where our around 100 employees are based.  

We are guided by our purpose – Together, we are more than business.

It revolves around three key focus areas – More innovation, More for our planet, and More for our people. To make sure we live that purpose, we’re steered by a set of values that bring our purpose to life and are the essence of our culture – We are easy to work with, We create lasting outcomes, We empower people to succeed. We are a strongly purpose & values-driven organization, both today and as we forge our way into the future. Learn more about our purpose and values here.

BearingPoint is a certified B Corporation, meeting high standards of social and environmental impact.

new_jobs.location: Viby, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

As a Solution Architect at Truvio, you will deliver scalable ecommerce solutions across the EMEA region. In this client-facing role, you will be the key in translating business objectives into innovative technical solutions. Your deep understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations will drive success for our clients, ensuring seamless integration and superior outcomes.

What You Will Do

Act as a trusted advisor to clients regarding our commerce solution architecture and best practices.
Facilitate workshops with customers and ERP partners to identify business needs and align on solution strategies.
Present solutions clearly and compellingly to both business and technical stakeholders.
Create and maintain documentation on solution architecture. Support pre-sales activities by providing insightful, business-focused solutions and estimates.
Lead AI implementation across our delivery processes to enhance solution effectiveness.
Collaborate closely with project managers and development teams to ensure alignment and viability of solutions and successful project delivery.
Define, estimate scope and document solution architecture aligning with both business requirements and technical feasibility as part of the project team delivering client implementations.
Coordinate with ERP partners for coherent and integrated solutions, particularly those involving Dynamics 365 F&O.
Stay current on ecommerce trends, platform capabilities, and Dynamics 365 F&O integration patterns.

Your background

Experience And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect or in a similar advisory role in ecommerce or related sectors.
Proven expertise with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including architecture and integration.
Strong understanding of ecommerce platforms and best practices in relation to ERP systems.
Experience in leading workshops and facilitating discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.

Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities focused on customer business needs.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of building trust.
Keen attention to detail and a structured approach to solution design.
Ability to navigate complex project environments and manage multiple priorities.
Strong understanding of AI technologies and their practical application, with the ability to identify opportunities to leverage AI in business and technical solutions.

Personal attributes

You are proactive, curious, and comfortable taking ownership of your projects.
You are service-oriented and build trust through professional communication.
You thrive on collaboration, creating strong working relationships across teams.
You maintain your composure and structure while managing shifting priorities or tight deadlines.
You are motivated by continuous improvement and innovative processes.
You cultivate a positive mindset and enjoy celebrating success with your team.

Who You Are

You are passionate about understanding customer businesses and creating solutions that meet their needs. You inspire trust and build strong relationships with stakeholders, confidently presenting to various audiences. Your curiosity and structured mindset drive innovation as you thrive in dynamic environments that demand adaptable solutions.

Other Information

Location: Viby, Denmark.
Employment Type: Full-time, permanent
Department: Services Commerce
Start: As soon as possible

About Truvio

At Truvio you will be part of a fast-growing modern SaaS environment who brings together established Microsoft Dynamics ISVs in one unified company, delivering a single, intelligent product portfolio built exclusively for Dynamics 365. This way we help customers and partners close the ERP Value Gap by unifying finance, operations, and commerce within a Microsoft-native suite.
We are a team of more than 450 employees worldwide, with colleagues based across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. With our core values Take ownership, Build Trust, Drive innovation and Succeed together do we have a mission to help organizations get more from their ERP investments.
We help organizations get more from their ERP investments - with solutions that simplify complexity, create clarity, and deliver outcomes that scale .
Our Mission is a world where every organization grows with confidence - powered by trusted expertise and continuous innovation.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Elections Department Singapore
new_jobs.description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[About the job]

GovTech is recruiting a Software Engineer for the Elections Department to modernise Singapore’s electoral technology and build systems that support secure, efficient, and transparent elections. The role combines full-stack software development, cross-team collaboration, and ownership of critical public-sector systems.
Electoral technology mission: The successful candidate will develop products and components serving millions of Singaporeans, contribute to high-impact electoral infrastructure projects, and help maintain systems requiring strong security, reliability, and public trust.
Core responsibilities: Work includes delivering maintainable and well-tested software, trnslating product goals into technical solutions, designing integrations, applying secure engineering and DevOps practices, managing deployments, monitoring system performance, resolving root causes, reducing technical debt, and collaborating across teams.
Experience and workplace: GovTech seeks experience with multi-component systems, .NET Core or .NET full-stack development, and preferably Angular and TypeScript, along with AWS, cloud-native technologies, automated testing, code reviews, secure coding, and continuous integration and delivery. The role also calls for problem-solving, collaboration, continuous learning, and interest in public-good digital solutions. GovTech describes itself as an equal-opportunity employer offering inclusive workplace practices, leave benefits, and wellness programs.

[What you will be working on]

Develop and deliver high-quality, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested software across multiple components and features.
Work closely with Product Managers and other stakeholders to understand product goals, priorities, and user needs, and translate them into effective technical solutions.
Contribute to solution design and technical discussions, considering security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and delivery needs.
Build and maintain integrations with internal and external systems and services.
Apply good engineering practices, including automated testing, secure coding, constructive code reviews, and producing and maintaining clear technical documentation.
Take ownership of your work from development through deployment, with increasing independence and follow-through.
Monitor the impact of your work through relevant metrics and logs, and proactively troubleshoot and address issues after deployment.
Investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and drive them towards resolution, seeking appropriate support when needed.
Identify and address technical debt, and contribute to improvements in code quality, tooling, engineering practices, and team ways of working.
Contribute to technical planning and develop a broader understanding of the product architecture, dependencies, and technical ecosystem.
Collaborate across teams to manage dependencies, share knowledge, support teammates, and deliver outcomes.

[What we are looking for]

Experience working on software systems with multiple components and integrations with internal and external systems or services.
Experience in modern full-stack web application technologies using .NET Core / .NET; with experience in Angular and TypeScript preferred.
Experience with AWS architecture and cloud application design; familiarity with Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, or other cloud-native technologies would be advantageous. .
Experience with software engineering and DevOps practices, including automated testing, code reviews, secure coding, maintainability, and CI/CD.
Ability to balance short-term delivery with long-term code health and maintainability.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and work towards solutions with increasing independence.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment with Product Managers, engineers, and other stakeholders.
Willingness to share knowledge, support teammates, and continuously learn and improve.
Interest in delivering digital solutions that contribute to the public good.

What we offer you:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation.   

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. 

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. 

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

new_jobs.title: Solution Architect - A26371
new_jobs.description:
Activate Interactive Pte Ltd ("Activate") is a leading technology consultancy headquartered in Singapore with a presence in Malaysia and Indonesia. Our clients are empowered with quality, cost-effective, and impactful end-to-end application development, like mobile and web applications, and cloud technology that remove technology roadblocks and increase their business efficiency.

We believe in positively impacting the lives of people around us and the environment we live in through the use of technology. Hence, we are committed to providing a conducive environment for all employees to realise their full potential, who in turn have the opportunity to continuously drive innovation.

We are searching for our next team members to join our growing team.

If you love the idea of being part of a growing company with exciting prospects in mobile and web technologies that create positive impact on people's lives, then we would love to hear from you.

Co-Development Business Unit
is hiring for DevOps Engineer

You will work in Singapore Government Agencies

Internal Code: A26371

This is a fixed term contract role. The engagement is 1 year.

What will you do?

We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead to drive the design, development, integration, and delivery of the Facilities Experience (FX) Platform, JTC's next-generation Facility Management (FM) digital platform. The role will be responsible for providing technical leadership across platform services, application modernisation, cloud architecture, integrations, and software engineering practices, while guiding delivery teams through the migration and transformation of existing FM applications.

The Technical Lead will work closely with product managers, service designers, stakeholders, and development teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions. This role is critical in establishing a robust platform foundation that supports both the migration of legacy FEMS 2.0 applications and the development of new digital services.

Platform Architecture & Technical Leadership

Define and maintain the overall technical architecture, principles, standards, and roadmap for the FX Platform
Lead the design and implementation of core platform capabilities, including authentication, single sign-on (SSO), role management, administration capabilities, workflow services, notifications, and shared platform components
Provide technical direction and governance across multiple delivery squads to ensure consistency, scalability, maintainability, and security
Establish architecture review processes and technical standards for all platform and application development activities.

Application Modernisation & Migration

Lead technical discovery and assessment activities for existing FEMS 2.0 applications and services
Develop migration strategies, architecture patterns, and implementation plans for transitioning applications onto the FX Platform
Guide teams in modernising selected applications and redesigning backend services where required
Ensure seamless integration and interoperability between platform services, migrated applications, and external systems
Manage technical risks associated with migration, cutover, data integrity, and operational continuity

Software Engineering & Delivery

Lead solution design, technical implementation planning, and development execution across platform and application teams
Review solution designs, code, APIs, and technical deliverables to ensure quality and alignment with architecture standards
Champion engineering best practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, observability, and infrastructure-as-code
Troubleshoot complex technical issues and provide hands-on support for critical architectural and integration challenges
Drive continual improvement of software delivery processes and platform reliability.

Cloud, Data & Integration

Design cloud-native solutions that are secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-effective

new_jobs.description:
Bizimle hayata katılmaya var mısın?

Biz kimiz?

Türkiye Finans; Orta Doğu bölgesinin en büyük sermayeli bankalarından biri olan SNB’nin %67 hisse ortaklığı ile varlığını sürdüren Türkiye’nin en güçlü katılım bankalarından biridir.
Türkiye Finansta biz; insanı odağımıza alarak ve dijitalleşmeye önem vererek teknolojik altyapımız ile hizmet anlayışımızı her geçen gün geliştiriyoruz. Yenilikçi bir anlayışla yolumuza devam ediyor, birlikte üretip başarmanın değerini biliyor ve ortak değerlere dayanarak sürekli büyüyoruz. Birlikte büyürken amacımız; sürdürülebilir ve kârlı büyüme ile katılım bankacılığını Türkiye'de tüm birey ve şirketlerle tanıştırmaktır.

Burada seni neler bekliyor?

Çeşitliliği zenginlik olarak gören bir bankada tek ekip ruhunu çokça yaşayacak ve yaşatacaksın.
Türkiye Finans Akademi’de kişisel gelişimden liderliğe, liderlikten hobi eğitimlerine binlerce içeriğe ulaşabileceksin.
Senin için tanımlanan dijital eğitim bütçen ile sana iş hayatında destek sağlayacak eğitimleri kendin için seçebileceksin. Eğer; ‘’eğitim hayatımda bir adım daha atmak istiyorum’’ dersen de Yüksek Lisans veya Doktora desteğimiz ile de bizi yanında bulabileceksin.
Sunduğumuz esnek kariyer imkanları ile istersen kariyerini farklı alanlarda da şekillendirebileceksin.
Liderlerini içeriden yetiştirmeye önem veren bankacılık kültürümüz ve yüksek iç atama oranımız ile her zaman destekleneceksin.
Kültür, sanat ve spor kategorilerinde 10’dan fazla kulübümüzle sosyalleşme imkanı bulabileceksin.
Yarına Varız mottomuzla hayata geçirdiğimiz sürdürülebilirlik projelerimiz ile sen de doğaya katkıda bulunma fırsatı yakalayabileceksin.
Önce sağlık mottomuzdan yola çıkarak “Hayat Ağacı” markamız altındaki psikolog, doktor, diyetisyen hizmetlerimiz ve spor derslerimizle her daim bizi yanında hissedeceksin
İş – özel yaşam dengeni korumak sadece senin değil, bizim de önceliğimiz. Destekleyici politikalarımızla vaktini özel yaşamına ayırabileceksin.
Sadece seni değil sevdiklerini de çok önemsiyoruz. Tam da bu nedenle eşini ve çocuklarını da özel sağlık sigortası kapsamına alabileceksin.
Hayat ve ferdi kaza sigortamız ile beklenmedik durumlara karşı güvende olabileceksin

Özetle; bizi biz yapan; Yenilikçilik Gücümüzdür, Müşteri Odağımızdır, Çeşitlilik Zenginliğimizdir, Tek Ekibiz, Başarı Tutkumuzdur değerlerimizi Türkiye Finans yolculuğunun her anında yanında hissedeceksin.

Biz Türkiye Finans ailesinde birlikte üretip başarmanın değerini biliyor, ortak değerlere dayanarak sürekli ilerliyoruz.

Bu ekip nasıl birini arıyor?

Bilgisayar mühendisliği, yazılım mühendisliği gibi ilgili bölümlerden mezun olan,
NET Framework, C#, SQL programlama dillerine hâkim ve tercihen React JavaScript konusunda minimum 4 yıl deneyim sahibi,
Çok katmanlı mimari, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) konseptleri konularında bilgi sahibi,
İlişkisel veri tabanı sistemleri konusunda tecrübe sahibi,
Takım çalışmasına yatkın, iletişimi kuvvetli,
Analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yetkinliğine sahip,
Scrum metodolojileriyle çalışmış veya bilgi sahibi
Tercihen bankacılık ürün ve uygulamalarında çalışmış (Kart, provizyon takip, ekstre vs)
Değişime ve öğrenmeye istekli,
Tercihen bankacılık sektöründe yazılım geliştirme alanında deneyimi olan ekip arkadaşları aramaktayız.

Bu pozisyondaki sorumlulukların ne olacak?

İhtiyaç analizi yapılmış uygulamaların geliştirilmesi, entegrasyonu, birim testlerinin yapılması,
Uygulamalarda düzeltme, iyileştirmelerin yazılım yolu ile yapılması,
Uygulamaların bankanın Yazılım Geliştirme Yaşam Döngüsü (SDLC) standartlarına uygun olarak geliştirilmesini sağlanması

Peki seni hangi adımlar bekliyor?

1- Başvuru
2- Teknik Mülakat
3- Envanter
4- SQL ve C# Testleri
5- İnsan Kaynakları Online / Yüz Yüze Mülakat

new_jobs.title: Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps)
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps) based in Turkey.

This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure powering large-scale web data products and distributed engineering teams. You’ll own the architecture of core control and context planes that enable services and AI-driven workflows to operate reliably and efficiently. Working across Kubernetes, Kafka, Java, Python, gRPC, and multi-cloud infrastructure, you’ll tackle complex distributed systems challenges at production scale. You’ll establish engineering standards, reliability practices, and service contracts that influence multiple product squads. The role combines hands-on architecture with technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional alignment. In a globally distributed, remote-first environment, you’ll have significant autonomy to solve challenging infrastructure problems and influence long-term platform strategy.

Accountabilities

Architect and evolve the control and context planes, advancing service and schema registries, SLO enforcement, health-aware routing, automated canary releases, and operational feedback loops.
Own the service chassis and golden path, maintaining and improving multi-language Java and Python client libraries, standardized workload specifications, Helm charts, and deployment pipelines.
Define and govern inter-service contracts, including gRPC and Protocol Buffer definitions, API gateway transcoding, versioning policies, and schema evolution standards.
Operate and improve the core platform infrastructure across Kubernetes, Terraform, HAProxy/Nginx, Confluent Kafka, real-time billing pipelines, Valkey, and database modernization initiatives.
Lead architectural strategy through Requests for Discussion (RFDs) covering workflow orchestration, gateway orchestration, multi-cluster routing, automated failover, and other critical platform initiatives.
Establish reliability engineering practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, fault isolation, and automated weighted canary deployments.
Participate in shared infrastructure on-call rotations, lead incident post-mortems, and convert operational insights into platform improvements.
Mentor engineers across multiple squads, review architectural proposals, and establish engineering practices that make reliable software development more consistent and efficient.

Requirements

10+ years of experience building scalable distributed backend systems, with a strong track record of creating internal platforms or core libraries adopted across engineering organizations.
Advanced Java expertise, including reactive frameworks such as Vert.x or Netty, combined with strong Python proficiency.
Deep experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, including schema evolution and backward compatibility in mission-critical systems.
Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes at scale, Terraform, and event-streaming platforms such as Kafka.
Experience designing automated telemetry pipelines, materialized views, feature stores, or other feedback systems that use production data to dynamically improve system behavior.
Strong reliability engineering background, including SLO/SLI definition, blast-radius analysis, fault tolerance, and rigorous service contracts.
Exceptional technical writing skills and the ability to communicate complex architectural concepts clearly while driving alignment across teams.
Strong written and interpersonal communication skills suited to a globally distributed, remote-first environment.
A curious, continuous-learning mindset with an interest in evaluating new technologies, architectures, and engineering approaches.
Experience with Temporal, DBOS, or similar durable execution platforms is a plus.
MLOps experience, including model serving, performance monitoring, or production drift detection, is advantageous.
Familiarity with zero-trust networking and service meshes such as SPIRE, mTLS, Cilium, Istio, or Envoy is beneficial.
Experience building developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs, or project generators is a plus.
Experience with large-scale web scraping or crawling, or contributions to distributed-systems and data-extraction open-source projects, is advantageous.

Benefits

Fully remote, remote-first working environment with flexible working hours.
Freedom and flexibility to work from the location where you are most productive.
Opportunity to work on core infrastructure supporting large-scale web data pipelines and distributed systems.
Exposure to cutting-edge open-source technologies, tools, and evolving AI and web data infrastructure.
Opportunities to attend conferences and connect with colleagues across the globe.
Collaboration with a diverse, multicultural, and globally distributed engineering community.
High level of autonomy and organizational trust.
Opportunities to influence platform architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy across multiple teams.
