new_jobs.title: Full Stack Developer / DevOps Engineer fluent in English
Application Architect ( .NET & React)
BACKEND ENGINEER - SPORTS BETTING (LIEGE - BELGIUM)
new_jobs.description:
THE SCOPE

With 30 years of history, today Gaming1 is one of the international leaders in both land-based and online games of chance (casino games, sports betting and poker). Its evolution at the heart of innovation is accompanied by a diversification and specialization of positions, with the creation of new cutting-edge jobs.

As part of its sustained growth, Gaming1 is looking for a Backend Engineer
to join its Sports Betting Area.

A Backend Engineer
at Gaming1 maximizes customer and business value through high-quality, user-centric product experiences.

Engineers operate within small, autonomous product engineering teams in a high-traffic, regulated environment, where decisions directly impact platform stability, customer trust, compliance, and time-to-market. This role sits within our Sports Betting team, where traffic surges around live sporting events and where compliance means jurisdiction-specific rules such as licensing and responsible-gambling requirements.

Because teams are intentionally small and product-oriented, Engineers are expected to be wide in their skillset, flexible in scope, and comfortable collaborating across disciplines. Backend work is not always isolated from product, operational, or cross-team concerns — success comes from end-to-end ownership and shared accountability, not role silos.

This role is part of a broader Product Engineering culture focused on autonomy, short feedback loops, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

YOUR ROLE

As a Backend Engineer
, your mission is to design, build, and evolve backend solutions that power customer experiences and business capabilities in a reliable and sustainable way.

You do this by:

Owning solutions across their lifecycle — from design and implementation to release, monitoring, and iterative improvement.
Collaborating closely with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and other stakeholders.
Applying strong backend craftsmanship while keeping product impact, reliability, and compliance front of mind — including through the traffic peaks that come with live sporting events.
Continuously improving systems, practices, tooling, and ways of working.
Your autonomy, scope, and influence are driven by your career ladder level, not by the job title alone.

YOUR PROFILE

What you bring

Experience as a Backend Engineer in product-oriented environments, ideally at scale and/or in regulated contexts
Strong backend fundamentals: API design, data modeling, testing, performance, resilience and operability
Experience building backend services with a statically-typed language and framework (e.g. C#/.NET, Java, Kotlin, Go), including event-driven architectures
Ability to own solutions end-to-end, from design to production and continuous improvement
Product-minded, collaborative, and comfortable working in small, autonomous, cross-functional teams
Strong sense of ownership, pragmatism, and continuous learning mindset
Experience working with relational databases (RDBMS), SQL, and ORMs

Nice to have

Hands-on experience specifically with .NET (C#) and messaging brokers and frameworks such as RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, or NServiceBus
Specific experience with PostgreSQL
Experience containerizing services and deploying them through CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes (we use GitLab CI/CD and Octopus Deploy)
Experience with real-time or high-concurrency systems (e.g. live odds, in-play betting, event-driven traffic spikes), or an interest in the sports betting / iGaming domain
Comfortable owning the observability of what you build — instrumenting, alerting, and monitoring your services in production (we use Datadog)

What We Offer

As well as enjoying a unique experience – centered around our values of Pleasure, Team Spirit, Performance, Boldness and Integrity – alongside 1.600 colleagues worldwide, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to the international development of a fast-growing family company.

Joining Gaming1 means becoming part of a human and entrepreneurial adventure where people are empowered to make an impact, grow and succeed together.

We offer:

the opportunity to work on ambitious international projects within a solid and growing group
a collaborative and high-performing work environment
leadership based on trust, autonomy, talent and shared values
continuous learning and career development opportunities through training and internal mobility
a competitive salary and benefits package aligned with the local market
a hybrid working model, with the possibility to work remotely up to 50% of your working time
an international and collaborative environment where people come first

new_jobs.description:
*Wir bei inovex mögen Vielfalt und Individualität. Deshalb freuen wir uns, wenn du unser Team noch bunter machst.

in Teilzeit (mind. 80%) oder Vollzeit
Start: ab sofort oder zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt
Standorte: Bern, Zürich, remote und bei unseren Kunden vor Ort

Was du bei uns bewegen kannst

Pionierarbeit & Standortscheduling:
Als technische Speerspitze gestaltest du das Wachstum von inovex in der Schweiz aktiv mit. Du verbindest technologische Glaubwürdigkeit im Pre-Sales mit nachhaltiger Projektdelivery und legst das solide Fundament, auf dem zukünftige Teams aufbauen.
Brücke zwischen Business-Vision & Code:
Du schliesst die Lücke zwischen Business-Bedürfnissen und Technologie. Vage Kundenideen und komplexe Anforderungen übersetzt du treffsicher in konkrete und funktionierende Softwarelösungen.
Hands-on Prototyping & Software Engineering:
Der Schwerpunkt deiner Rolle liegt in der aktiven Umsetzung moderner Softwarelösungen und Systemarchitekturen direkt im Kundenprojekt. Mit hoher Geschwindigkeit baust du funktionale Prototypen sowie MVPs auf.
Pre-Sales & Strategische Beratung:
Du führst und/oder begleitest Kundengespräche und übersetzt Business-Visionen in pragmatische, machbare Softwarekonzepte. Du führst interaktive Discovery- sowie Architektur-Workshops durch und lieferst fundierte Aufwandsschätzungen.
Architektur-Standards & Agile Führung:
Für unsere Projekte definierst du technische Standards sowie strukturierte Konzepte für komplexe IT-Landschaften. Deine Projekte steuerst du nach agilen Methoden – idealerweise untermauert durch Zertifizierungen wie Professional Scrum Developer oder Scrum Master.

Wer gut zu uns passen würde

In der Rolle als Solution IT Architect & Consultant liegt dein Schwerpunkt klar auf der strategischen Beratung, der vorausschauenden Konzeption und dem Aufsetzen moderner Architekturmuster – weniger auf der reinen operativen Umsetzung. Du begleitest Entscheidungsträger auf Augenhöhe, bewertest neue Technologien und legst das Fundament für zukunftsfähige Softwarelösungen. Dazu bringst du Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse aus den folgenden Bereichen mit:
Fullstack-Engineering & Architektur-Expertise:
Du blickst auf mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Software-Architekturen zurück. Dein Tech-Stack umfasst moderne Frontend- und Backend-Technologien (z. B. TypeScript, Kotlin / Spring Boot oder .NET / C#) sowie Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und CI/CD-Pipelines.
Cloud-Native & Modern Tooling:
Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastrukturen (bevorzugt AWS oder Azure) ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du entscheidest, wann Serverless- oder Hybrid-Cloud-Szenarien sinnvoll sind.
Data & AI Grundlagen:
Ein solides Verständnis moderner Datenplattformen und Data Engineering rundet dein Profil ab, sodass du Kunden auch bei datengetriebenen Architekturen ganzheitlich beraten kannst.
Beratungspersönlichkeit & Unternehmergeist:
Das Schliessen der Lücke zwischen Business-Bedürfnissen und Code treibt dich an. Du denkst unternehmerisch, überzeugst Stakeholder durch fachliche Exzellenz sowie Empathie und schätzt die Abwechslung zwischen strategischem Consulting und konkretem Coding.
Sprachkompetenz & Reisetätigkeit:
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung (mind. Level C1), gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Französischkenntnisse sehen wir als zusätzliche Ergänzung. Eine projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft (hauptsächlich innerhalb der Schweiz, gelegentlich nach Deutschland) ist für dich kein Problem.

Dein Team

In Bern bauen wir gemeinsam das Schweizer inovex-Team auf. Dabei geht es nicht um die Mitarbeit in einem bestehenden Team, sondern um die aktive Mitgestaltung des Markteintritts und der Positionierung von inovex in der Schweiz. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Kernteam, das den Anspruch hat, inovex im Schweizer Markt nachhaltig zu etablieren – in enger Abstimmung und Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kolleg:innen in Deutschland. Dabei verbinden wir die Erfahrung, Methoden und technologische Exzellenz eines etablierten Unternehmens mit unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum vor Ort.

Unsere Konzepte implementieren wir bevorzugt mit Open Source Software im Rahmen agiler Projekte. Die meisten der von uns entwickelten Lösungen integrieren wir in bestehende IT-Systeme, weshalb wir von Beginn unserer Projekte an auf integrierte Qualitätssicherung setzen.

Bei uns verläuft kein Projekt wie das andere – je nach Kunde, Team und Technologie-Stack ist jede Lösung einzigartig. Unser Fokus ist jedoch immer derselbe: Mit innovativen Technologien und einem hohen Anspruch an die Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme wollen wir nicht nur unsere Kunden glücklich machen, sondern auch uns selbst.

Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds

With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. It’s not just about improving buildings - it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works.

The digital transformation of buildings is a fast-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology - it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first.

Software Development
40-60%

Tools, Services and Infrastructure (TSI) develops and supports the tools, applications and infrastructure for the global SI B PRO R&D organization, owning the full lifecycle of the PLM/ALM toolchain used by 5,000+ end users, with 3,000+ tickets resolved per year and 100+ tools managed. Within TSI, Applications & Data Insights develops applications, integrations and data products, extending the ALM ecosystem with automation and AI. Our landscape includes:

IBM Jazz ALM for agile project management, requirements, test and system design — plus Report Builder and a large in-house extension portfolio (50+ Jazz plugins and custom tools)
Source code, build and quality tooling: Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, UrbanCode Deploy, build and test environments
R&D financial and business processes (Jedox-based budgeting and cost tracking)
Reporting and analytics: IBM Report Builder today, moving progressively to Power BI and Snowflake for Management Events , alongside KPI dashboards and data products

You will join our development team to further develop the tools above into user-centric, future-proof solutions, and you will contribute directly to extend and create plugins and tools, and infusing AI capabilities into the tool landscape (Jazz / WISPR / MCP integrations, Jazz Copilot).

Your New Responsibilities

You support the development of new features across the TI tool landscape, collaborating closely with experienced software engineers and participating in projects, change management and training for new technology implementations
Building on this, you contribute to the entire engineering cycle by assisting in requirements analysis, architecture and design, coding, deployment and ongoing support
In this context, you produce clean, efficient code to specification, integrate software components and REST-based interfaces, and help verify and deploy programs and systems
Additionally, you maintain and upgrade existing software, troubleshoot coding issues efficiently, and help fix defects to ensure application and plugin reliability
Complementing these tasks, you help create technical documentation for various audiences and contribute to the team wiki and knowledge base

Your Talents And Experience

You are currently enrolled in a Swiss university degree program in computer science, software engineering or a related field and have initial practical experience in software development
You have hands-on experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C# or .NET Core
You are familiar with web technologies and frameworks, including basic frontend development with JavaScript, HTML and CSS
You have knowledge of REST APIs and integration patterns, and are confident in using version control systems such as Git
You demonstrate a high level of analytical ability, learn new technologies quickly and work in a structured, thorough and independent manner
You have very good English and or German skills

Mobile working from anywhere within Switzerland
Opportunity to develop an international professional network
Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members

Our corporate culture - your new working environment

The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment - it is at the heart of our day-to-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically.
